1.plot: Hilda notes that Oga and his friends are acting funny and that they're scheming something bad. Oga and Beel deny this, but do so in such a poor manner that Hilda easily notices they're lying. After Oga introduces the next episode, Hilda begins to think of a new dance for Baby Beel in place of the Pudding Pudding dance. Oga responds with a fake laugh.

1.title: FR - Beelzebub - S01E57 - Won't You Eat a Manju? / Won't You Get in a Mixed Bath?
1.plot: Koma gets an idea from Oga's Super Milk Time training to switch bodies with Aoi Kunieda by offering her Manju. He has some fun moments with Aoi that gets pervy but he also spends a good bit of time with the kids, of which Koma fits in pretty well. His attempts to push them into his own designs are definitely fun since he wants to utilize the body switching ability for his own ends, which is essentially to get into Aoi’s body and play with her end. Hilda wins a ticket to an Onsen where Oga's family and her enjoy a relaxing bath. Oga, Beel, and Hilda bond a little bit while Furuichi thinks he has a chance to see a woman naked in the mixed hot spring bath.

1.title: FR - Beelzebub - S01E58 - Akumano Academy is Open!
1.plot:
Behemoth visits St. Ishiyama to find Oga and Beelzebub, but he gets welcomed by Zenjuro, Ittousai, and the principal. Hilda holds Oga down while they watch the fight. Meanwhile, Furuichi and the delinquents arrive at Akumano Academy. They stumble upon the Pillar Generals. Agiel attacks only to meet Aoi who arrived in the nick of time.

Will Aoi defeat Agiel?

1.title: FR - Beelzebub - S01E59 - We're the Strongest!
1.plot:
While Aoi fights Agiel, Oga and Hilda meet Behemoth and Jabberwock up close and personal. Then, at Akumano Academy, Lord En and quetzalcoatl has the delinquents playing a "game," and at the same time, Oga fights Jabberwock to free Hilda from the enormous jaws of Sodom.

Will Oga and Beel have the power to free Hilda from Jabberwock and his dragon, Sodom?

1.title: FR - Beelzebub - S01E60 - I Won't Say Goodbye
1.plot:
It begins with a bunch of Ishiyama delinquents crying and mourning over the loss of Oga and Baby Beel. Their tears stop short by the river when Alaindelon cruises like a speedboat and Oga and Beel pop out of the man.

At Oga's house, Hilda explains that the Great Demon Lord has no interest in destroying humanity which means the goal of raising Beel to destroy all humanity is no more. Beel and his gang will have to go home, and mass hysteria follows.

Will Oga, Beel, and the gang part ways forever?

meta.plot: Violent delinquent Oga encounters a baby one day, which crawls onto his back and immediately forms an attachment to him. Though he doesn't know it yet, this baby is named Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV, or "Baby Beel" for short—the son of the Demon Lord!

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E01 - Koji the Killer
1.plot: Harley Carter returns to his Ontario hometown after a public scandal.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E02 - The Astronaut & The Lion King
1.plot: Harley and Sam re-open a cold case expecting a dead end but find a whole new angle to the crime.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E03 - The Farmhand Who Bought the Farm
1.plot: An accident turns into a homicide investigation during Harley's first day as consulting detective.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E04 - Harley's Got a Gun
1.plot: Harley learns that shooting people isn't so easy during an investigation.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E05 - Pig, Man, Lion
1.plot: A young unstable actress is manipulated by an older more experienced theatre director who takes advantage of her fragile mental state.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E06 - The Flood
1.plot: The storm of the century hits as a brutal attack during a wedding forces Sam & Harley to take cover in the police precinct.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E07 - Kiki-Loki
1.plot: Harley gets in on a big-budget commercial alongside a famous Japanese mascot.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E08 - Voiceover
1.plot: An obnoxious shock jock dies on air during a broadcast.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E09 - Happy Campers
1.plot: Dave, Harley and Sam leave their work behind for a fun weekend; Trouble finds them and leads them to a dark part of Dave's past.

1.title: FR - Carter - S01E10 - The Ring
1.plot: A new clue surfaces in the mystery of Harley's mother's death just as the producer of Call Carter arrives into Bishop.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E01 - Harley Wears A Wig
2.plot: Harley Carter's first official case as a P.I. is a kidnapping with a surprising twist.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E02 - Harley Loses a Finger
2.plot: Harley and the gang find themselves locked into a cat-and-mouse game with a charming British conman.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E03 - Harley Gets Replaced
2.plot: The surprising new star of "Call Carter" comes to town to ride along with Harley.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E04 - Harley Gets An Office Job
2.plot: After preventing a depressed actuary from taking his own life, Harley goes undercover at an insurance company.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E05 - Harley Gets A Hole In One
2.plot: Sam has to go undercover at a fancy country club to prevent a diamond heist.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E06 - Harley Insisted On Wearing Pants
2.plot: Harley, Sam, and Dave solve a murder at a nudist colony.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E07 - Harley Wanted to Say Bonspiel
2.plot: Harley, Sam and Dave hit the rink to solve a mystery at the local curling club.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E08 - Harley Gets to Be Best Man
2.plot: Well-intentioned advice from Harley ends up with Dave as an unwilling bank robber.

2.title: FR - Carter - S02E09 - Harley Doesn't Get His Man
2.plot: A case of mistaken identity puts Harley in the middle of an online dating disappearance.

meta.plot: An actor returns home after a public meltdown. Partnering with his police detective friend, he tries to use his acting experience to solve real crimes.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Young American flyers arrive in war and discover that the bureaucracy is more deadly than the enemy.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Yossarian pursues desperate measures to get home, while Milo sees war as a growth industry.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Yossarian needlessly expends energy to avoid a feared mission; disaster catches up with him, when he least expects it.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: On a surreal trip, Yossarian begins to realize the magnitude and influence of Milo’s business empire.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Reeling from one violent tragedy, Yossarian encounters incomprehensible darkness in Rome, and is faced with an impossible choice.

1.title: FR - Catch-22 - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Alive and intact, Yossarian is thwarted by an old adversary. Confronted by a devastating loss, he undergoes a transformation.

meta.plot: Pianosa Island, Italy, World War II. Bombardier John Yossarian tries to fulfill his duty, maintain sanity and return home as soon as possible, but incompetence and bureaucracy constantly stand in his way.

Every year Le Chef (English: The Chef), owner of the restaurant Le Paris, and a figure in French cuisine incorporates a young offender on probation into his team. Romain, just released from prison, arrives in this new world where gastronomy and excellence mix. After a difficult integration, he shows a real talent for cooking and climbs the ranks.
Follow the life and crimes of five diverse and treacherous manicurists working at the Nail Artisan of Manatee County salon, where there is a lot more going on than silk wraps and pedicures.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E01 - Tirana
1.plot: Desna and her girls take pride in doing nails at the Nail Artisans of Manatee County, but amidst painting hooves and dreaming of a better life, she finds herself entangled in a money laundering scheme with the Dixie Mafia.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E02 - Funerary
1.plot: Following their entanglement with Roller, Desna and Virginia desperately prepare a cover story to tell the girls and the Dixie Mafia. Desna's dream salon is falling out of her grasp.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E03 - Quicksand
1.plot: As Virginia's lies deepen, Desna plays catch-up covering their tracks. Desna still has a small shot at her dream salon, and with the help of her crew, she is determined to get it.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E04 - Fallout
1.plot: Haunted by Roller, Desna is desperate to get out from under Uncle Daddy's thumb. Bryce drifts deep into the Dixie Mafia. Polly reunites with a former gold-digging "friend," while Quiet Ann is in a lady-mess.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E05 - Batshit
1.plot: Desna and Jennifer may be Dr. Ken's only hope, as Bryce wrongly accuses him of a heinous crime. Virginia and Desna are forced to go to Polly for help to rid the world of two horrible birds from Desna's past, with one well-aimed stone.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E06 - Self-Portrait
1.plot: All of our girls go to their new fancy salon for the first time. They aren't met with the kindness of strangers. Desna and crew decide to compete in Florida's premiere nail design competition for a big cash prize.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E07 - Escape
1.plot: After the big nail competition, Desna may finally get out from Uncle Daddy's grasp. Jennifer struggles knowing Desna's dark secret, while Polly discovers her previously unknown maternal instincts.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E08 - Teatro
1.plot: With a shocking revelation affecting the entire crew, Jennifer finds unexpected solace in her square-dancing instructor. Polly uses all of her powers of bad for good, for the first time, while Quiet Ann is torn about a big decision.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E09 - Ambrosia
1.plot: Desna goes searching for the truth with her crew right behind her, save for Jennifer, who is learning how to cope as a Dixie Mafia wife. When Desna's sleuthing hits pay dirt, she goes to the only person who can save her. Time is running out.

1.title: FR - Claws - S01E10 - Avalanche
1.plot: Following a harrowing escape from Roller's grasp, Desna is on the run. Roller is close behind, running from the Russians. In the end, only Desna can save Jennifer, Roller, and her crew with a sacrifice greater than any she's ever had to make.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E01 - Shook
2.plot: Desna and the girls struggle to keep hope alive while still working under the thumb of the new Russian regime, spearheaded by Riva. Desna remains in the dark about her gangster/gyno boyfriend, Ruval. Virginia tells Dean that she's pregnant.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E02 - Cracker Casserole
2.plot: Desna, now pinned under the stiletto-tipped nail of Riva's sister, Zlata, must come up with an idea to generate more customers for the clinic. Quiet Ann helps Dean and Virginia get to a very important appointment.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E03 - Russian Navy
2.plot: Desna's relationship with Ruval deepens when he introduces her to his mother, Matilde. Polly grows concerned when Marnie continues to pull away from her. Jenn, still depressed by Bryce's recent indiscretion, falls off the wagon.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E04 - Scream
2.plot: Desna, in an attempt to cozy up to Matilde, Ruval's mother, puts together a spa day for her and a couple of young girls from his charity. Quiet Ann gets a surprise visit from her brother, who convinces her to attend a family dinner.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E05 - Vaginalologist
2.plot: Desna continues to grow closer to Zlata, despite the crew's increasing concern as her relationship with Dr. Ruval intensifies. Meanwhile, Dean gets an opportunity to showcase his talents and Uncle Daddy gets his mojo back.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E06 - Double Dutch
2.plot: Faced with a dilemma, Desna and Dean take a road trip to seek guidance from a childhood mentor. Back in Palmetto, Jenn must lean on Polly and Quiet Ann for help with a personal crisis. Virginia struggles to run the salon on her own.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E07 - Burn
2.plot: When Desna with the help of Uncle Daddy and her crew plots revenge on those who betrayed her, she realizes that vengeance comes at a high cost.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E08 - Crossroads
2.plot: Desna is offered a deal with the Russian devil, aka Zlata, that's more intriguing than nail art on acrylics. Polly and Quiet Ann get dealt some hard-ass betrayal from their baes while Jenn's affair comes back to haunt her.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E09 - Til Death
2.plot: Polly gets an unexpected visit from her long-lost sister that sends her spinning out of control. Uncle Daddy and Roller join forces with their Dixie Mafia brethren and make a plan to take out the Russian and Haitian mafias for good.

2.title: FR - Claws - S02E10 - Breezy
2.plot: As a hurricane approaches, Desna proceeds with the plans for her big day, keen for the the opportunity to settle all scores. Opposing forces converge at a lavish golf resort, determined to prevail, but will Desna and crew survive the storm?

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E01 - Just the Tip
3.plot: In the wake of Virginia being shot, the crew must regroup to face their off-kiltered new adversaries, Mac and Melba Lovestone, so they can run Bayside Rapture Casino like the bosses they are.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E02 - Muscle & Flow
3.plot: Desna and her crew start working at the casino and discover the Lovestones are involved in some illegal business with a very important person.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E03 - Welcome to the Pleasuredome
3.plot: After discovering Mac and Melba’s surprise gift in the salon, Desna and the crew go to their “fundraiser” to retrieve information to use against them.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E04 - Boy, Bye
3.plot: After Desna discovers Mac and Melba have done something horrible to a loved one, she realizes just how far she is willing to go to save him.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E05 - Zaddy Was A Rolling Stone
3.plot: Desna decides her trust issues are rooted in being abandoned by her father. Her world is turned upside down after seeking him out. The Lovestones retaliate against Desna for getting in the way.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E06 - Fly Like An Eagle
3.plot: After successfully leveraging what she knows about Governor Patel to win her brother back, a victorious Desna returns to the casino, only to learn that Dean is more entranced under Mac and Melba's spell than she realized.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E07 - Chicken P***Y
3.plot: Desna works to separate Dean from Mac and Melba. Quiet Ann gets the crew deeper into trouble.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E08 - What Is Happening to America
3.plot: The crew makes elaborate plans to pay back the casino's debts only to find out they have a long way to go before they are out of the woods.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E09 - Melba Toast
3.plot: Desna and the crew have to tie up loose ends for the Triads if they want to stay alive. Meanwhile, guilt pushes Toby to do the unexpected, putting the entire crew in jeopardy.

3.title: FR - Claws - S03E10 - Finna
3.plot: Just when the crew thought that they could boss up, fate takes a turn on Desna and Roller. As the walls close in on Desna's Queendom, she is forced to make a choice no one would have expected.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E01 - Be a Captain
1.plot: When family tragedy strikes, playboy Chava and his workaholic sister Isabel fight over the presidency of their family's professional soccer team.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E02 - We Make Soap
1.plot: While Isabel explores life away from the Cuervos, Chava and Felix scramble to prevent a public relations disaster.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E03 - Uniform Response
1.plot: As Chava tries to make his mark on the team, Isabel looks into Mary Luz's past, and Tony tries to convince Coach Goyo to let him debut.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E04 - Slap
1.plot: Chava battles with Coach Goyo. Meanwhile, Isabel struggles to do business with a sexist sponsor.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E05 - Barriers to Exit
1.plot: Felix considers an offer from a rival team, Chava tries to impress a cute reporter, and Isabel makes a new friend.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E06 - Lucky to Play
1.plot: While the players anxiously prepare for the most important game of the season, Rafael reflects on his upcoming retirement.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E07 - Our Guggenheim
1.plot: Felix carefully maps out his plans for the team's lineup next season, but Chava has ideas of his own.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E08 - Aitor
1.plot: A documentary profile offers a behind-the-scenes look at European superstar Aitor Cardone's arrival to the Cuervos.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E09 - Spanish Fever
1.plot: As Chava rides the wave of Aitor's fame, Moises begins feeling insecure about his place on the team. Isabel deals with the fallout from her interview.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E10 - New Dick in Town
1.plot: Aitor's presence upsets the balance of the team, Isabel struggles with being ostracized, and Potro's jealousy continues to create problems.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E11 - Push
1.plot: Felix is left to manage the team on his own while a new arrival keeps Chava busy.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E12 - Happy Birthday Mr. President
1.plot: Chava has the worst birthday ever as scandal engulfs Aitor and Isabel seizes an opportunity.

1.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S01E13 - Iglesias vs. Iglesias
1.plot: Chava and Isabel's rivalry comes to a head as the team faces its greatest challenge and Mary Luz asserts herself.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E01 - Descenso
2.plot: Chava's family worries about where he could be, while Isabel faces unexpected challenges with the team's division status.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E02 - Welcome to Second
2.plot: When cash flow problems plague the Cuervos, the players revolt. Isabel makes a serious personal decision. Hugo Sanchez searches for Chava.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E03 - Who Are You Looking For?
2.plot: Chava locks himself in Aitor's apartment for 70 days. When he finally emerges, a drug-fueled revelation has him questioning his entire identity.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E04 - Ho Oponopono
2.plot: Chava returns and is focused on reconciliation. Isabel is skeptical but must focus on a lawsuit, unmotivated players and emotional struggles.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E05 - Matahari
2.plot: A traitor works to undermine the Cuervos in the playoffs. Rafael and Isabel’s professional arguments impact their marriage.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E06 - The Oasis in the Desert
2.plot: A new coach shakes things up for the team. Isabel confronts Chava, who retaliates by calling immigration services on Potro.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E07 - La Salvadora
2.plot: Isabel gains fans of her own as Cuervos continues to win. A jealous Chava throws himself into developing a casino deal.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E08 - The Truce
2.plot: Mary Luz and Chava try to convince the wild and wealthy Ricky Lamas to invest in their casino. Mary Luz encounters someone from her past.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E09 - The Curse of the Black Feather
2.plot: Isabel tries to convince her team there is no curse. Chava investigates Mary Luz's history. Potro's fake marriage is not what he expected.

2.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S02E10 - Iglesias vs Iglesias 2
2.plot: The Cuervos and Carneros face off in the championship game to see who will ascend to Division 1. Chava makes an unexpected power play.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E01 - The Third Generation
3.plot: Isabel and Chava adjust to life as co-presidents of the Cuervos team and take on the governor as their first obstacle.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E02 - The Treaty of Versailles 14
3.plot: When the Cuervos bring a new high-profile teammate on board, Rafa must clean up a mess caused by Chava and Isabel.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E03 - The Leftovers
3.plot: Isabel's decision puts a strain on the Cuervos team lineup just as the draft begins, and they must scramble to recover.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E04 - Business or Pleasure?
3.plot: Chava's gubernatorial candidacy hits a snag when old incriminating photos of him surface. Isabel mixes business with pleasure.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E05 - The Road Back
3.plot: Chava's relationship with Isabel Cantú ends up benefitting the Cuervos financially, while creating a challenge for his sister.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E06 - Our Cuau
3.plot: The siblings fight over whether to fire Cuau. Chava gets nervous filming his first campaign ad for governor.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E07 - Church and State
3.plot: Rafa is interviewed about his career. Chava thinks he’s a better political candidate when he improvises -- until an angry moment is caught on TV.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E08 - Puebla...
3.plot: The team struggles to keep key player Moisés happy after a disappointing commercial. Cuau is offered a chance to enter the political arena.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E09 - Girl, Interrupted
3.plot: Chava makes a big decision regarding his campaign and personal life. Isabel receives a shocking and revealing email not intended for her.

3.title: FR - Club de Cuervos - S03E10 - The Heart of Nuevo Toledo
3.plot: A reporter makes a troubling discovery about Don Salvador Iglesias and his past. Isabel and Chava turn to their mothers for clarity on their father.

meta.plot: When the patriarch of a prominent family dies, his heirs battle to determine who will gain control of his beloved soccer team: The Cuervos of Nuevo Toledo.
Medium Yoh Asakura enters a battle tournament held every 500 years, competing with other shamans in a bid to become the all-powerful Shaman King.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E01 - The Boy Who Dances with Ghosts
1.plot: Shaman Yoh Asakura offers to help his new classmate Manta face a notorious thug with the aid of a legendary samurai spirit.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E02 - Another Shaman
1.plot: Yoh and Manta encounter the shaman Ren, who shows no mercy when fighting a punk. Furious at Ren's misuse of his powers, Yoh faces him in battle.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E03 - Anna and Tao Jun
1.plot: Anna tells Yoh about the new tournament to crown the next Shaman King. Ren's sister Jun challenges Yoh to a battle, with Amidamaru as the prize.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E04 - Happy Place
1.plot: After possessing Ryu, Tokageroh takes Manta hostage. Yoh and Amidamaru fight him, but Tokageroh wields Harusame and they're at a disadvantage.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E05 - Over Soul
1.plot: One of the Patch Officiants, Silva, unleashes his five animal spirits against Yoh to determine if he's worthy of participating in the Shaman Fight.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E06 - Yoh vs. Horohoro!
1.plot: Now qualified for the tournament, Yoh faces his first opponent, Horohoro of Hokkaido, a proud Ainu shaman who can manipulate ice and snow.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E07 - A Form of Courage
1.plot: Faust VIII, a necromancer who can manipulate corpses, enrages Yoh when he targets Manta for sadistic experimentation before their match.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E08 - Progress
1.plot: With Ren as his next opponent, Yoh distances himself from Manta to ensure his friend's safety. Later, Yoh returns to Izumo to continue his training.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E09 - Yoh vs. Ren: Again!
1.plot: The last battle in the preliminary round begins. Fated rivals Yoh and Ren fight to the limit, but who will punch their ticket to the main tournament?

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E10 - Night in the Flame
1.plot: Ren returns to China to take care of unfinished business. The BōZ Brothers ambush Yoh and Tamao, but a familiar face comes to their rescue.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E11 - A Tale of Two Men
1.plot: Back home, an imprisoned Ren vows to defeat his father after losing to him in a fight. Meanwhile, Yoh and the others set out for China to rescue Ren.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E12 - Ren vs. En: The End of the Tao
1.plot: Ren and his allies make their way toward En. The head of the Tao family may be a formidable foe, but Yoh and company aren't ones to back down.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E13 - And Hao!
1.plot: Yoh's group meets the self-proclaimed future king. Those in the main tournament board a flight, not knowing their first trial is about to begin.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E14 - Lyserg the Avenger
1.plot: As Yoh and the others prepare to travel to a town where a Patch Tribe village once stood, the dowser Lyserg appears and asks to join their group.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E15 - When the Pieces Come Together
1.plot: Yohmei tasks Anna with delivering an ancient book belonging to the Asakura family to Yoh in the United States. Horohoro's guardian Kororo goes missing.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E16 - Enter the Ultra-Pompandour
1.plot: Searching for answers, Yoh and company arrive at the ancestral village of the Patch Tribe, where they find themselves beset by Hao's followers.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E17 - Guns of the Angels
1.plot: Facing Boris, Ryu unleashes a new power acquired from his training with Yoh's grandfather Yohmei. An unexpected person appears before Manta and Anna.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E18 - Great Spirits and My Team
1.plot: Yoh's group reaches the Patch Tribe Village as they find the Great Spirits and learn the purpose of the Shaman Fight. A cheery shaman joins the team.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E19 - Jaguar
1.plot: While looking for Lyserg, Yoh and friends are confronted by Faust, who makes a startling offer. Finally the stage is set, and the Shaman Fight begins.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E20 - Joco's Christmas
1.plot: Team Ren faces off against Hao's lackeys, Team Tsuchi-gumi. Joco recalls his past with a certain person after being cornered in a desperate situation.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E21 - Iron Maiden Jeanne
1.plot: The second Shaman Fight begins as Team X-I of the X-Laws take on Egypt's Team Niles. But X-I's newest member is someone Yoh's group knows all too well.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E22 - I'll Go Anywhere with you
1.plot: Team Funbari Hot Springs begins their first match versus the Icemen. But Yoh vows to defeat them with one attack thanks to the ultra senji ryakketsu.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E23 - The Power of Yoh
1.plot: Overwhelmed by Faust's new Over Soul, the Icemen crumble under the pressure — then launch a sub-zero counterattack as the end of the match approaches.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E24 - Trust No One
1.plot: Yoh meets with Lyserg for a long-awaited conversation, but others lurking nearby intervene. Finally, X-Laws' team X-III takes on Hao's Hoshi-gumi team.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E25 - The Great Onmyoji, Hao Asakura
1.plot: Yoh watches helplessly as Team X-III desperately fights Hao, who reveals the secret of his birth and his thousand-year history with the Asakura clan.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E26 - Mikihisa Typhoon
1.plot: Yoh's friends are stunned by the revelation about Hao. Later, a mysterious masked man appears before Team Ren with an offer to make them stronger.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E27 - Farewell Forever
1.plot: Ren gains new power after taking on his powerful opponent. As the Shaman Fight continues, Hao's followers begin targeting teams outside the ring.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E28 - Yoh's Decision
1.plot: Horohoro and Joco try to escape Hao's follower Peyote Díaz with an injured Ren, but Yoh makes a surprising entrance. Elsewhere, Anna makes her move.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E29 - Emeth
1.plot: As Anna helps Mikihisa's teammates escape to their Shaman Fight, Tamao and Jun's battle against Hao's Hana-gumi heats up.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E30 - Mt. Osore Le Voile
1.plot: Yoh accepts Jeanne's conditions as payment for healing Ren, leaving their friends in shock. Anna recalls the first time she met Yoh five years ago.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E31 - Mt. Osore Le Voile ||
1.plot: Yoh tries to understand his fiancée, who continues to reject him and her connection to the demon attacking the town. Matamune's past is revealed.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E32 - Mt. Osore Le Voile |||
1.plot: Bit by bit, Anna and Yoh get closer when they visit the shrine together for New Year's. But Anna's powers bring on a dangerous situation.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E33 - Mt. Osore Le Voile IV
1.plot: Yoh and Matamune arrive at Mt. Osorezan to rescue Anna from the giant demon born from people's hearts, but Yoh only has one shot to save her.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E34 - To Be King
1.plot: Yoh's path to being Shaman King is over. Ryu and Manta spy on Jeanne's successful resurrection of Ren, which has an unexpectedly powerful side effect.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E35 - Reunion
1.plot: Horohoro finishes the fight with Brocken's team. Lyserg brings an injured Horohoro to Yoh's team when Peyote attacks with the intent to kill.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E36 - Redseb and Seyrarm
1.plot: Mikihisa's teammates, siblings Ludsev and Seyram, seek revenge against the person who killed their father. But Yoh steps in before it's too late.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E37 - Winds of Laughter
1.plot: Golem's new user goes on a rampage while Ren, Ludsev and the others come up with a plan to bring them back to their senses. Hao gives Opacho a task.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E38 - Graduation
1.plot: Opacho appears in front of Yoh with a message: Yoh must return to the Shaman Fight or Hao will destroy Golem and the children. What will he decide?

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E39 - The Summit
1.plot: Yoh's battle with X-Laws to re-enter the Shaman Fight comes to an end as Luchist Lasso and Jeanne enter the fray. Later, Yoh reveals a plan to beat Hao.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E40 - Humility
1.plot: As the Shaman Fight matches enter the final stages, Team Ren faces a fierce battle against The Wisdom Kings, who can nullify a person's Over Soul.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E41 - Encounters in Hell
1.plot: Horohoro clinches the win for Team Ren, meaning their next opponent is Team Funbari Hot Springs. Meanwhile, a dubious group approaches Yoh and others.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E42 - A Great Trial
1.plot: Yoh continues to fight his way through hell with his new ability. As the Shaman Fight gets more complicated, an unprecedented trial awaits Yoh's team.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E43 - The End of a Dream
1.plot: Marco and the others desperately resist Hao's attack to keep Jeanne safe. Hao's clash with the X-Laws causes an unexpected crisis.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E44 - A Leisurely Chat
1.plot: Hao's lackeys begin to doubt his intentions. Anna confronts Hao, who reveals his ultimate oversoul. Yoh's group steps into the Shaman Fight ring.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E45 - The First and the Last
1.plot: The Shaman Fight between Team Funbari Hot Springs and Team Ren begins! But before Yoh can launch his counterattack, the match takes an unexpected turn.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E46 - True Justice
1.plot: Yoh and the others enter the area for the second tournament, but before it can begin, Yoh makes a surprising declaration.

1.title: FR - Shaman King [SUB] - S01E47 - Plants
1.plot: The winner of the Shaman Fight will finally be revealed. Yoh and the others try to stop Hao from joining with the Great Spirit.
