5.plot: When Richard gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. But, just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E23 - The Grades
5.plot: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball’s grade point average, he is forced to return to kindergarten.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E24 - The Diet
5.plot: Gumball and Darwin find out why Richard's diet wasn't working, and after they help him lose weight, he becomes more obnoxious.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E25 - The Ex
5.plot: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

5.plot: The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell Richard, Gumball, and Darwin what it is called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E28 - The Uncle
5.plot: When Gumball finds out that Ocho has an uncle named Mario, he becomes desperate to meet him.

5.plot: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E30 - The Heist
5.plot: Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can lead to trouble.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E31 - The Singing
5.plot: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E32 - The Best
5.plot: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E33 - The Worst
5.plot: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E34 - The Deal
5.plot: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E35 - The Petals
5.plot: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E36 - The Puppets
5.plot: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

5.plot: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E38 - The Line
5.plot: The Wattersons will do whatever it takes to get into the first screening of the latest Stellar Odyssey sequel.

5.plot: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

5.plot: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E01 - The Rival
6.plot: When Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin become jealous of their new sibling, and spark a baby war.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E02 - The Lady
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin find out that Dad has been dressing as a woman to make friends.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E03 - The Sucker
6.plot: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius, who decides to make Darwin his new target. However, it backfires when Darwin ruins his life.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E04 - The Vegging
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin want to veg out all day, but their plans go awry and they have to save the rest of the family.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E05 - The One
6.plot: Tobias tries to be Gumball’s best friend.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E06 - The Father
6.plot: The kids try to help Richard bond with Frankie.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E07 - The Cringe
6.plot: Gumball and Hot Dog Guy discover why they're so awkward with each other.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E08 - The Cage
6.plot: The kids convince Mr. Corneille to become a cage fighter and set up a fight against a fearsome Russian fighter.

6.plot: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

6.plot: When Clayton shapeshifts into Gumball to take his detention, he starts framing others for misdemeanors so Gumball and Darwin must track Clayton down to stop him.

6.plot: Gumball and Principal Brown make a pact to tell each other what problems their girlfriends have.

6.plot: Gumball and Darwin try to find out the name of their neighbor, Antlers Guy, but accidentally blow his witness protection cover.

6.plot: Sarah finds a notebook from the Awesome Store which magically makes what she draws happen. Unfortunately, she draws bizarre love stories throughout Elmore.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E15 - The Brain
6.plot: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E16 - The Parents
6.plot: Nicole and her parents reconnect after a long forced absence.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E17 - The Founder
6.plot: Richard creates chaos in the Chanax building when he is mistaken for the long lost CEO. Nicole and a disgruntled employee must save everyone from Richard's dangerous ideas.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E18 - The Schooling
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin take on Larry's jobs for 5 minutes and realize how bad it is.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E19 - The Intelligence
6.plot: Technology reaches human intelligence then becomes dysfunctional as it picks up human flaws.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E20 - The Potion
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin use a magic potion to shrink Hector.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E21 - The Spinoffs
6.plot: Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats to replace Gumball.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E22 - The Transformation
6.plot: Gumball is asked to settle a dispute between Penny and her family.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E23 - The Understanding
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin get into trouble misunderstanding a new kid in school.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E24 - The Ad
6.plot: The Wattersons are forced to rent their house to a pair of elderly fainting goats.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E25 - The Ghouls
6.plot: Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their scare back?

6.plot: Gumball decides to engross himself in plant culture to appease Leslie after making an offensive comment.

6.plot: Anais and Jamie form an unlikely partnership when they're accused of a crime they didn't commit.

6.plot: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?

6.plot: Gumball and Darwin believe they've turned Miss Simian into a neck-cushion.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E36 - The Factory
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin save the day at the Rainbow Factory.

6.plot: Gumball and Darwin's clothes go missing after a swimming lesson; when Gumball is forced to wear a tuxedo from the lost and found office, he believes it makes him look like a certain dapper British secret agent.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E38 - The Web
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin realize that the adult residents of Elmore are dangerously naive when it comes to being safe online, and in fact are in serious need of the boys' help with even the simplest of tasks.

6.plot: After staying up all night, the boys baby-sit Penny's little sister and manage to lose her in the blink of an eye.

meta.plot: The life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year old cat who attends middle school in Elmore. Accompanied by his pet, adoptive brother, and best friend Darwin Watterson, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with various family members: Anais, Richard, and Nicole Watterson, and other various citizens.
The bullied outcasts at prestigious Al Rawabi School for Girls plot a series of risky takedowns to get back at their tormentors.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E01 - School Was My Happy Place
1.plot: The students are interrogated after a violent incident at a top-notch all-girls school, and new pupil Noaf finds herself stuck in a tight spot.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E02 - Game On!
1.plot: Vengeful, Mariam returns to school, but her troubles continue, especially when her bestie deserts her. A clash between Noaf and Layan sparks drama.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E03 - What Goes Around Comes Around
1.plot: The newly allied Mariam and Noaf set out to take down their first bully at the school's open day. Dina's efforts to fit in lead to a change of heart.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E04 - Broken Glass
1.plot: Rania and Layan vow to make whoever was responsible for Ruqayya's scandal pay. In spite of their success, the misfits argue about the next steps.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E05 - And She Became a Stranger
1.plot: On an overnight class trip, Layan and Rania make post-curfew plans. In the wake of a traumatic incident, Noaf starts to have second thoughts.

1.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S01E06 - The Calm Before the Storm
1.plot: Emboldened, Mariam is hell-bent on getting back at her last target, despite Noaf and Dina's warnings about the real danger of her actions.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E01 - New Beginnings
2.plot: It's a new school year, and Sarah dreams of going viral, but her posts aren't getting much traction — until she posts a video that gets some attention.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E02 - Fancy Purple
2.plot: Sarah gets invited to Tasneem's house for a sleepover, but Hiba isn't happy about it. Meanwhile, Nadeen befriends the mysterious Shams.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E03 - Meet Your Favorite Candidate
2.plot: Tensions build as the candidates for school president give speeches to their peers. Sarah gets caught in the middle of two competing campaigns.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E04 - A Blast from the Past
2.plot: At Omar's birthday party, Sarah is on cloud nine — until a message from an admirer brings her back down to earth. Hiba gets back at Tasneem.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E05 - Holy Uniform
2.plot: When Sarah tries to escape school, an unlikely ally catches wind of her secrets. Meanwhile, Jawad struggles to keep a secret of his own.

2.title: FR - AlRawabi School for Girls - S02E06 - If I Could Do It All Again...
2.plot: Nadeen teams up with a past rival for a risky mission to save their friend. Farah chases her dream of performing with Tasneem in front of the school.

meta.plot: À sa sortie de prison, le rappeur Bosco prépare son grand retour. Mais sa sœur Vita lui vole la vedette et met à rude épreuve les liens familiaux qui les unissent.
After a harrowing home invasion and kidnapping in 2015, a couple is accused of staging the ordeal when the woman reappears in this true-crime docuseries.

1.title: FR - American Nightmare - S01E01 - Part One: The Boyfriend
1.plot: In 2015, California couple Aaron Quinn and Denise Huskins were attacked at home during the night. After Denise was kidnapped, Aaron became a suspect.

1.title: FR - American Nightmare - S01E02 - Part Two: Gone Girl
1.plot: Days later, Denise reappears seemingly unharmed and recalls the details of her terrifying abduction as doubts from authorities begin to swirl.

1.title: FR - American Nightmare - S01E03 - Part Three: The Others
1.plot: More attempted kidnappings lead detectives to a new — and unexpected — suspect. Aaron and Denise go head-to-head with the Vallejo Police Department.

meta.plot: Follow a select group of students throughout their final make-or-break year at Australia's elite dance Studio, Brent Street.

Using his trademark wit, host Graham Norton oversees 10 comedic stars, brought together to make each other laugh by using every unpredictable comedic tool in the box … without cracking a smile themselves. As the clock counts down and the tension rises, whoever can outlast their competitors will be crowned the winner and win a grand prize of €50,000 for their charity of choice.

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E01 - Sure Here We All Are Now
1.plot: Host Graham Norton kicks things off as 10 funny Irish folk pit their wits - and whatever else they’ve brought with them - against each other in the hopes of landing some all-important laughs. Keep an eye out for a very (very) early yellow card and a little bit of Tony’s French fancy.

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E02 - A Woman's Heart
1.plot: Oh, it's all kicking off! We’re only into our second hour and we’ve already got a handful of comedians teetering on the edge of elimination as Aisling gets a little emotional and a surprise blast from our Irish past pushes the group dangerously close to the edge.

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E03 - Clown Down
1.plot: We’re really cooking now as the game hits the midway point and the cast are forced to weather a Jason-shaped storm, Tony breaking out some very big, very sexy guns and Amy filling us in with some fun facts that may or may not be true (spoiler - they’re not). Could we also see the game’s first red card?

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E04 - Stir Crazy
1.plot: It’s all starting to unravel as the group go a little bit stir crazy, prompting the introduction of a real life mermaid, a faded rockstar, a former Irish president and some very flatulent fingers.

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E05 - Hiya!
1.plot: It’s raining red cards in the penultimate episode of this side-splitting series. Martin takes to the stage in an attempt to bring some class to proceedings, only to realise it’s a fruitless task when someone whips out their talking melons. Graham also lays on a banquet that leaves the group seeing double.

1.title: FR - LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland - S01E06 - Masters at Work
1.plot: Graham finally steers the good ship LOL into port in this incredible last episode of the series that sees our final five throw everything plus the kitchen sink at their fellow funny folk in the hope of being crowned our first ever Champion… who will be the Last One Laughing?

meta.plot: Follows the harrowing journey of Delhi Police Officer Kabir Malik as he battles an insidious adversary, Zarar, who has chosen the path of terrorism.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E01 - Delhi Police Raising Day
1.plot: In the heart of India's bustling capital - Delhi, chaos erupts as a series of deadly blasts rock the city. Panic and fear grip the residents as the blasts seem relentless, leaving behind a trail of destruction. The city's peace is shattered, and the responsibility to catch the perpetrators falls upon the brave men and women of Delhi Police.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E02 - One Wrong Call
1.plot: Aided by Gujarat ATS chief Tara Shetty, Kabir and Vikram analyse evidence but their frustration continues as their investigation gets riddled with dead ends. An unexpected turn of events unfolds and a phone call from the terrorist's hideout gives a clue that may help Delhi Police track down their location.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E03 - The Hunt
1.plot: After a relentless pursuit, Kabir and Vikram finally locate the terrorists' hideout. In a heart-pounding ambush, Delhi Police confront the terrorists in a fierce gunfight, resulting in casualties on both sides.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E04 - The Ghost Is Back
1.plot: Zarar is on a sinister mission once again to execute bombings in the city of Jaipur. He succeeds in carrying out these deadly acts. As Kabir learns about the explosions, he jumps into conducting an illegal inquiry of his own in Jaipur.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E05 - The Loss
1.plot: As Kabir and team conduct their investigations in Goa, they get a breakthrough. Meanwhile, Zarar and his brother Sikku prepare to unleash chaos upon the city, setting the stage for a showdown. A tragic accident unfolds. As the episode comes to a close, the information regarding Nafeesa's mother shocks the Police force and advances the inquiry towards learning the truth about Zarar's intentions.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E06 - The Truth
1.plot: Kabir reaches Darbhanga and confronts Nafisa about Zarar's true identity. Shocked by this revelation, Nafeesa faints and Kabir takes her to the hospital. Realising Zarar’s truth, Nafeesa surrenders to the police and discloses that Zarar was in Bangladesh. Kabir along with Tara Shetty head to Delhi to seek permission from the Home Minister for a cross border operation to bring Zarar back.

1.title: FR - Indian Police Force - S01E07 - Home Coming
1.plot: Kabir travels to Bangladesh to find Zarar after receiving approval from the Home Minister. With the assistance of Jagtap and Rana, and a spectacular series of events in the pursuit of Zarar, Kabir ultimately succeeds in bringing back India's most wanted terrorist to his soil.

meta.plot: When a mysterious enemy targets his family, a Taipei triad member heads to Los Angeles to protect his strong-willed mother and oblivious younger brother.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A family emergency sends a ruthless killer from Taipei to LA. Cash-strapped Bruce takes a new gig. When a crisis erupts, estranged brothers reunite.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E02 - Favor for a Favor
1.plot: Charles introduces Bruce to his unique line of work while trying to get rid of a body. But he continues to be a moving target everywhere he goes.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E03 - Whatever You Want
1.plot: When Bruce goes missing, Mama Sun and Charles drop in on a mahjong game and a seafood restaurant for answers. A common goal makes allies out of enemies.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E04 - Square
1.plot: Hesitant to join the family business, Bruce vows to focus on school and improv. But when a triad meeting proves dangerous, the Suns are forced to pivot.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E05 - The Rolodex
1.plot: In the fallout of the attacks, Bruce works hard to be a useful asset, Mama Sun leverages her knowledge and a wounded Charles wakes up in a strange place.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E06 - Country Boy

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E07 - Gymkata
1.plot: With the ghosts gathering in Los Angeles, the family regroups until an unexpected visitor disrupts their plans. A momentous occasion descends into chaos.

1.title: FR - The Brothers Sun - S01E08 - Protect the Family
1.plot: The Suns' lives and legacy hang in the balance as old wounds and hard truths come to light. Bruce makes a choice that could change the family forever.

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E01 - Episode 1

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E04 - Episode 4

When ex-soldier Maya sees her murdered husband on a secret nanny cam, she uncovers a deadly conspiracy that stretches deep into the past.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: News about the murder weapon sets the investigation on a new course. Maya goes searching for answers and learns something surprising about her sister.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Maya chases the car that's been following her. With the adults distracted, Claire's children investigate the mystery of their mother's old photo.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The detectives question the owner of the motorbike from the crime scene. Kierce's condition catches up with him at a critical moment.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Maya sees an unexpected face when she takes Lily to see her grandmother. Kierce struggles to come to terms with his test results.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Suspicion falls on Maya when she's found at a crime scene — but she's the one who makes an accusation. McGreggor discovers something new about Kierce.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: As the police close in on a suspect, Maya decides to take drastic action. Shane begs her for answers — and learns the truth about their shared past.

1.title: FR - Double piège - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: With the last pieces of the puzzle starting to fall into place, Maya confronts her husband's family one last time, and Kierce seeks help from Corey.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E01 - Just You Wait and See
1.plot: In Nazi-occupied Paris, Christian Dior fears for his resistance-fighter sister, Catherine. Coco Chanel makes a deal that will forever haunt her.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E02 - The Hour
1.plot: Christian embarks on a quest to free Catherine from German captivity. Coco is sent on an undercover mission and recruits her friend Elsa.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E03 - Nothing but Blue Skies
1.plot: Coco suffers the consequences of her relationship with Spatz. Christian's pursuit of Catherine takes a fatal turn.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E04 - What a Difference
1.plot: After Paris is liberated by Allied troops, Nazi collaborators face punishment—including Coco. Christian is conflicted about ever designing again.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E05 - Give Your Heart and Soul to Me
1.plot: Christian is offered a job that will forever change the course of his life. Coco struggles with her outsider status as she's self-exiled in Switzerland.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E06 - If You Believed in Me
1.plot: Desperate to stand up to her business partners, Coco begins a war over her most famous perfume. Christian must redefine his relationships.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E07 - It All Came True
1.plot: Christian takes unexpectedly bold and daring next steps to launch his fashion house. Coco figures out how to use Elsa's “talents” to her advantage.

meta.plot: The shocking story of how fashion icon Christian Dior and his contemporaries including Coco Chanel, Pierre Balmain, and Cristóbal Balenciaga navigated the horrors of World War Il and launched modern fashion.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E01 - The Map
1.plot: Miguel stumbles into an old flame at the hotel, then meets a guest with a peculiar last name — and even stranger tattoo — who ignites his dreams of gold.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E02 - The Sacred Place
1.plot: As their plan goes awry, the gang pivots to help Miguel. With the cops hot on their trail, Miguel and Wilson enlist a new member and dash to the cenote.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E03 - The Stone
1.plot: With Miguel facing a dismaying fate, Lucas's gadgets come in handy, as does Lilí's idea — still, they're bound for an explosive confrontation.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E04 - The Legend of the Three Keys
1.plot: After Lilí saves the day, the gang considers splitting, but a dire threat binds them back together. Juan offers a cryptic, yet monumental clue.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E05 - The Exchange
1.plot: The bandits hit their next target: Churches. With time running out, they decide to divide and conquer... but outsmarting their pursuers won't be easy.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E06 - The Traitor
1.plot: After their stunt is stalled, the group must figure out if there's a traitor among them. Soon, more than one revelation comes to light.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E07 - The Treasure
1.plot: As doubt looms over Miguel, Wilson encourages him to continue the adventure. But is discovering the treasure truly written in the stars?

meta.plot: A gang of skilled misfits ventures to uncover a long-hidden Mayan treasure. Their strategy? Hazy. Their dynamic? Off. Luckily, they're pretty ingenious.
Ivan, a clandestine bus driver, navigates the end of his marriage and daily challenges with humor in this quirky comedy series with a live audience.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E01 - Don't Stop Me Now
1.plot: Sandra spills the beans about Ivan's shady van service, leading to a media frenzy. Ivandro's new ride becomes his ticket to employment.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E02 - Breaking the Rules!
1.plot: On a sweltering day, Ivan's radiator also loses its cool. Sandra's air conditioner is her only respite — until Ivan pinches it for a raffle.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E03 - I Deserve It!
1.plot: On Sandra's 10-year work anniversary, Ivan's vacuum sets off a fridge disaster and an ice robbery using an unorthodox bag.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E04 - Don't Make Yourself at Home
1.plot: Sandra decides to sell the house she shares with Ivan, who sabotages potential buyers. A lawyer offers up his expertise.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E05 - Hole Lotta Nothing Going on
1.plot: Sandra's sale leaves Ivan homeless, while city hall construction leaves his van without parking. His attempt to resolve the situation only sparks chaos.

1.title: FR - Terminus - S01E06 - Missing the Bus
1.plot: Ivan almost forgets Ivandro's employee of the month party, for which he's in charge of decorations. But maybe he's not the best person for the job.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Do Min Joon, an alien who landed in Korea 400 years ago, discovers that he has three months left on Earth. And that is when he meets Cheon Song Yi, the biggest Hallyu star in Korea.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Min Joon embarrasses Song Yi in public while she films for a documentary special about her daily life.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Song Yi suffers from appendicitis, and forces Min Joon to take her to the hospital. He takes the opportunity to protect her from his premonition

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: When an actress dies from an accident, Song Yi is immediately the target for blame. She seeks refuge in Min Joon's apartment, uncovering secrets that he'd like to keep buried.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Song Yi hides away in Min Joon's apartment after the suspicious death of fellow actress Han Yoo Ra. Prosecutor Yoo Suk begins an investigation to look into whether her death was a suicide or not.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Following the Han Yoo Ra scandal, Song Yi postpones renewing her contract with her management.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: As the threats intensify, Song Yi turns to Min Joon for help. He slowly becomes more human-like by being around her so often, and agrees to be her temporary manager.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Song Yi thinks stress is contributing to her "hallucinations" of Min Joon saving her. The investigation intensifies as witnesses to Jae Kyung and Yoo Ra's relationship begin to disappear.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Min Joon gets sick after he shares a kiss with Song Yi. Se Mi decides to finally meet Min Joon for herself.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Song Yi has difficulty dealing with her feelings for Min Joon, who's also trying to distance himself from her and not reveal his true nature to anyone.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Jae Kyung will go at any lengths to get Song Yi and Min Joon. Jae Kyung begins to view his brother in a different light.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Song Yi refuses to hear what Se Mi has to say about her savior from 12 years ago. Min Joon recovers from his injuries but realizes that his heart is now broken.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Min Joon does his best to distance himself from Song Yi and hold up his end of the deal with Jae Kyung.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: When Song Yi's wires break while shooting, it's a game to the death with no holds barred between Min Joon and Jae Kyung.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Song Yi recovers from her injuries but Hee Kyung is still in a coma. Min Joon can't stay away from protecting Song Yi.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Min Joon and Song Yi admit their feelings for one another and start dating, but his departure date looms near.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Hee Kyung won't stop until he finds his sister-in-law and uncovers his brother's dark secrets. Song Yi and Min Joon can't deal with the fact that he'll need to leave in a month.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Min Joon's powers weaken as he stays on Earth longer than he should. Hee Kyung discovers his brother's true self but it will be more difficult than it seems to have him pay for his crimes.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Hee Kyung must find a way to stop Jae Kyung before he himself ends up on his brother's hit list. Song Yi discovers the price Min Joon must pay if he stays with her.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: With one week left before he leaves, Song Yi and Min Joon spend each day as if they had seventy more years left together.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: Do Min Joon's departure is too difficult to bear for Song Yi, even three years later.

meta.plot: An alien who came to Earth 400 years ago is almost able to return to his own planet, but when he meets a famous actress, he doesn't want to go home.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E01 - Vengeance of the Gods
1.plot: On his trip back to Earth, Ulysses' son is carried off by the Cyclops to give sight to his followers with Telemachus' life force. Ulysses destroys the Cyclops and saves Telemachus, Yumi and Numinor. In retaliation the ancient Gods then send his ship, the Odyssey, into an unknown part of space with the bulk of its crew cursed to remain lifeless, floating in mid-air until Ulysses finds the Kingdom of Hades.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E02 - The Black Sphere
1.plot: On an isolated asteroid Ulysses meets an old, blind, scholar called Heratos and his assistant, a young Zotrian woman named Atena. Heratos gives Ulysses a map that will lead him beyond the galactic glaciers - or so he claims.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E03 - Flowers of Fear
1.plot: The Odyssey comes across a lifeless city world. On hearing that its people had the technology to bring the dead back to life, Yumi takes Numinor to the planet to revive him. However, she learns why there is no life in the city.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E04 - Cronus, Father of Time
1.plot: Ulysses is saved from a Trident attack by Chronos, the god of time, who wants to use him as leverage to be allowed to reenter the home of the gods.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E05 - The Lost Planet
1.plot: Numinor is awaken when The Odyssey chances upon a satellite world that has strayed far from it's orbit around he and Yumi's home world. Ulysses, Telemachus, Nono, Numinor and Yumi head down to the planet and make the startling discovery that the entire population has been turned to stone by an evil Witch.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E06 - Guardian of the Cosmic Winds
1.plot: Aeolus, King of the winds, kidnaps Ulysses to provide entertainment for his daughter's birthday party. Unable to watch her father's cruel sport, she frees the captives and helps them escape.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E07 - The Eternal Punishment
1.plot: Ulysses encounters Sisyphus, a king condemned to fill a crater with boulders for all eternity for having dared to want the secret of immortality. Zeus has promised Sisyphus he can leave if he makes Ulysses take his place.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E08 - Mutiny on Board
1.plot: A space storm revives the companions as crazed automatons who take over the ship and try to crash it into space glaciers.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E09 - Secret of the Sphinx
1.plot: Passing through the domain of the great Sphinx, Ulysses must answer his riddle to leave safely. His treacherous daughter kidnaps the children and plots to make Ulysses her slave.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E10 - Temple of the Lestrigones
1.plot: The Odyssey arrives on a tropical planet, where the ruling tyrant uses a magic prism to shrink them.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E11 - Trapped Between Fire And Ice
1.plot: Trying to help a stranded astronaut, Ulysses tries to find a hidden base on one of the deadly twin planets Scylla or Charybdis.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E12 - The Seat of Forgetfulness
1.plot: Ulysses follows a Trident carrier in hopes of learning more about the way out of Olympus, and finds himself trapped in bizarre worlds. To save the children, he will have to give up his memories.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E13 - Song of Danger
1.plot: Pirates kidnap the children to force Ulysses and No-No to brave the danger of the Sirens, said to guard a map of the Olympus universe.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E14 - Phantoms from the Swamp
1.plot: Coming across a piece of Zotra that could bring Numinor back to life, Ulysses and Yumi pursue it to a swamp planet where they are ambushed by monsters who can copy their forms

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E15 - Before the Flood
1.plot: Ulysses and the crew land on a planet similar to prehistoric earth. They encounter a winged female named Sauria, whose people are under attack from mutant vultures called Keconopters.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E16 - The Magic Spells of Circe
1.plot: The crew of the Odyssey are enslaved by the magic of the enchantress Circe and turned into pig-people to build a tower that will house all the knowledge of the universe.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E17 - The Hidden Truth
1.plot: The shapechanger Nereus calls Ulysses for help when Shark Men, servants of the gods, take over his planet.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E18 - Lost in the Labyrinth
1.plot: Princess Ariadne comes upon the Odyssey, and asks for Ulysses' help in saving her lover Theseus, who has been exiled to her father's labyrinth to be killed by the fearsome Minotaur.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E19 - At the Heart of the Universe
1.plot: Mercurius, the bubble-dwelling "grandson of the gods," enlists Ulysses' help in taking a jewel from the brow of the giant Atlas under the promise that it will give him the power to send Ulysses home.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E20 - The Magician in Black
1.plot: Ulysses is saved from an attack by the most powerful magician in the universe who breaks the gods' curse on his crew; however, as payment for his services, demands to hunt Ulysses's best men.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E21 - Rebellion on Lemnos
1.plot: Princess Hypsipyle of the planet Lemnos is found by Ulysses; she tells them that the women of her planet are being forced by the Shark Men to build ships for the gods.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E22 - The City of Cortex
1.plot: The Odyssey is dragged to a planet populated by machines, and governed by the tyrannical computer Cortex. One of its inhabitants, a "female" robot named Nanette, falls in love with No-No.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E23 - Strange Meeting
1.plot: Ulysses and the children are sent back in time and meet the original Ulysses, Telemachus and Penelope of Homer's epic.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E24 - The Lotus Eaters
1.plot: Needing raw materials to repair the Odyssey, Ulysses travels to a world where the inhabitants are addicted to eating seeds which induce amnesia.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E25 - Calypso
1.plot: The Odyssey responds to a distress call from Queen Calypso, who tells him that if he saves her planet she will tell him the way back to earth. Calypso has been ordered by Zeus to betray Ulysses, but she falls in love with him and cannot carry out the gods' orders.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E26 - The Kingdom of Hades
1.plot: In the final episode, Ulysses and his companions reach the Kingdom of Hades. They meet Orpheus, who seeks Ulysses' help to find his love, Eurydice, who has been taken to the Kingdom of Hades by Charon. Hades, the god of death, tells Ulysses that he must leave his companions behind if he wishes to return to Earth. He rejects the offer, which was a final test, and they all return home.

meta.plot: Ulysses and his crew struggle against the divine entities that rule the universe, the ancient gods from Greek mythology.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A family emergency sends a ruthless killer from Taipei to LA. Cash-strapped Bruce takes a new gig. When a crisis erupts, estranged brothers reunite.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E02 - Favor for a Favor
1.plot: Charles introduces Bruce to his unique line of work while trying to get rid of a body. But he continues to be a moving target everywhere he goes.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E03 - Whatever You Want
1.plot: When Bruce goes missing, Mama Sun and Charles drop in on a mahjong game and a seafood restaurant for answers. A common goal makes allies out of enemies.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E04 - Square
1.plot: Hesitant to join the family business, Bruce vows to focus on school and improv. But when a triad meeting proves dangerous, the Suns are forced to pivot.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E05 - The Rolodex
1.plot: In the fallout of the attacks, Bruce works hard to be a useful asset, Mama Sun leverages her knowledge and a wounded Charles wakes up in a strange place.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E06 - Country Boy
1.plot: Mama Sun travels to Taiwan and hears upsetting news. A celebrity's holiday home provides the perfect safe house for the brothers. Bruce bonds with Grace.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E07 - Gymkata
1.plot: With the ghosts gathering in Los Angeles, the family regroups until an unexpected visitor disrupts their plans. A momentous occasion descends into chaos.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E08 - Protect the Family
1.plot: The Suns' lives and legacy hang in the balance as old wounds and hard truths come to light. Bruce makes a choice that could change the family forever.

meta.plot: When a mysterious enemy targets his family, a Taipei triad member heads to Los Angeles to protect his strong-willed mother and oblivious younger brother.
Identical twins change their diets and lifestyles for eight weeks in a unique scientific experiment designed to explore how certain foods impact the body.

1.title: FR - Bien dans son assiette : La preuve par deux - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Identical twins join a scientific study and must stick to either a plant-based or omnivorous diet for eight weeks to determine what is the healthiest.

1.title: FR - Bien dans son assiette : La preuve par deux - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The twins begin their diets with a mix of successes and struggles. The recommended dietary guidelines raise concerns. A renowned chef changes course.

1.title: FR - Bien dans son assiette : La preuve par deux - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The twins adjust to cooking their own meals. With some animal products linked to health problems, innovators turn to plants for sustainable alternatives.

1.title: FR - Bien dans son assiette : La preuve par deux - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The study results are revealed to the twins as they review their weight, gut and brain health, and more. A movement in the food industry gains momentum.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E01 - THE SEWN-LIP MAN
1.plot: On social media, rumors of a mysterious phenomenon, known as "Hologram Ghosts," are spreading. Hiro Amanokawa, a first-year junior high school student, activates a mysterious device left behind by his father, and encounters a Digimon called Gammamon.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E02 - THE MYSTERY OF THE MUSEUM
1.plot: Ancient Egyptian mummies are on special display at the museum. There is a rumor that a huge man fully covered in bandages was witnessed kidnapping people in the area. Hiro and Gammamon decide to visit the museum to investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E03 - SCRIBBLES
1.plot: The new paranormal phenomenon is spreading. It is said that if red scribbles appear somewhere on your body in a digital photo, that area will begin to act strange. The red scribbles then appear on Ruli’s photo.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E04 - THE DOLL’S MANOR
1.plot: Trick or treat! It’s Halloween and Ruli is getting ready with decorations. However, one by one, people begin to disappear. Hiro and the gang investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E05 - Divine Anger
1.plot: Something has disrupted the digital money system, angering the envoy of the god of wealth. What has caused the disruption? Hiro and the gang are on the case.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E06 - The Cursed Song
1.plot: Ruli and the gang are researching the paranormal sightings around the city when they stop to investigate a rumor about a haunted karaoke box. It’s said that if a certain song is sung, a mysterious and creepy voice begins to sing along with you.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E07 - Birds
1.plot: A mysterious group of crows are going around releasing captive birds around the city, including Ruli’s friend’s pet sparrow. The gang agrees to track down the missing bird and get to the bottom of this unknown threat.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E08 - Nightly Procession of Monsters
1.plot: A mysterious nightly procession of monsters has been causing accidents on the highway. Ruli asks the gang to join her at the go-kart track, when they’re met with unexpected danger. Will they be able to survive until morning?

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E09 - Warped Time
1.plot: Something is off with Hiro's sense of time. He's constantly late, and almost misses his curfew. Ruli suggests a trip to the library for a change of pace. They meet some unexpected visitors and learn the cause of Hiro's problems.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E10 - Game of Death
1.plot: There is a strange rumor that if anyone who gets a 20-win streak in this fighting game, they will disappear shortly after meeting a mysterious and beautiful character. It turns out Kiyoshiro knows this game.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E11 - Kamaitachi
1.plot: A mysterious wind is causing all sorts of damage around town, and things are tense between Ruli and Angoramon. Ruli suspects that Angoramon is hiding something from her. Will they be able to patch things up before it’s too late?

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E12 - Chain Letter
1.plot: Digimon are using a chain letter to multiply in great numbers. Kiyoshiro receives the same chain letter and deletes it, but it ends up spreading to many others. Hiro and the gang must stop the Digimon before they overrun the city.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E13 - Executioner
1.plot: Digimon are being killed indiscriminately, and the gang comes face to face with an urban legend. Hiro and the others formulate a plan to take the rumored executioner down, when something unexpected happens.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E14 - Zashiki-warashi
1.plot: Kiyoshiro invites the gang along to his academic conference, upon hearing that his hotel is haunted by a Zashiki-warashi. There, they investigate the rumor of the haunting, while Gammamon has trouble accepting what happened to Bokomon.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E15 - The Fortuneteller's Manor
1.plot: There is a mysterious fortuneteller going around the city granting people their wishes, but something sinister is happening underneath the surface. Mika wants her fortune told, so she asks Ruli to help her find the nomadic diviner.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E16 - The Maneater's Forest
1.plot: Hiro goes out camping with Gammamon and hears about the rumors of people being spirited away in the forest by the local deity, Kasumi-sama. They enjoy their time outdoors, when they are surrounded by a mysterious fog.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E17 - Icy Hell
1.plot: Kiyoshiro takes the gang to a geothermal power plant that he helped set up when all of a sudden, they find themselves in freezing temperatures. How will they get out of this icy hell?

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E18 - The Land of Children
1.plot: Hiro is approached by two Hawkmon, who ask him to help look for their missing human friend. While investigating the incident, Hiro encounters a mysterious Digimon, who kidnaps children and takes them to a land where no adults are allowed.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E19 - The Witching Hour
1.plot: It’s time for Gammamon’s first errand. But it is said that strange things happening during the witching hour. And just like the rumors, a mysterious voice echoes.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E20 - Prison of Fire
1.plot: Hiro and Ruli visit a theme park when a couple of Digimon show up looking for Blacktailmon, who has been visiting Hiro. Things get heated when Hiro's confronted, and Gammamon steps up to fight.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E21 - The Spider's Lure
1.plot: A scientist who is a former colleague of Hiro’s mom drops by. She takes everyone to an insect exhibit at the mall, but they’re attacked by a highly intelligent Digimon who’s hungry for their brains.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E22 - Nightmare
1.plot: Jellymon is running a sleep therapy scheme when everything goes sideways! Jellymon’s customers are waking up with injuries. The gang go to investigate, but will they be able to escape the nightmare?

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E23 - Moaning Bug
1.plot: Something is turning the Digimon all over town into violent bugs that attack people! Clockmon comes to seek the help of Hiro and the gang to stop this violence.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E24 - Twisted Love
1.plot: Recently, something seems to be attacking all the people who interact with Yuto. Yuto decides to ask his friend, Hiro for help. Along with Ruli, Hiro and the gang investigate the mysterious phenomenon behind Yuto’s acquaintances turning into plants.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E25 - The Crimson Banquet
1.plot: Ruli is invited to a party for the super high-end brand, SV. Their business branding is centered around blood and the color crimson. However, something about this bothers Angoramon and the gang decides to investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E26 - Cannibal Mansion
1.plot: Angoramon runs into an old friend from the Digital World, Digitamamon. Digitamamon is living alone in an empty mansion. The gang all go to visit, but they soon learn that the mansion is known as a man-eating mansion.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E27 - Monster’s Beauty Serum
1.plot: Hiro comes across a rumor about people disappearing after hearing the sound of water dripping three times. The gang is forced to confront this rumor head-on when he witnesses a dorm staff turning into water before his own eyes.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E28 - Face Taker
1.plot: There is a rumor among Digimon about people with masks and no faces underneath. Hiro’s friend Kotaro loses his face and is worn out. Hiro suspects a Digimon is behind this and starts an investigation.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E30 - Bad Friend
1.plot: Ruli’s schoolmate Kayono hasn't been to school for about a month. People worry about her and visit her, but they disappear one after the other. Kayono gets caught up with a couple of bad influences.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E31 - Killer Blade
1.plot: There is a rumor about a Digimon appearing out of nowhere with a katana, attacking other Digimon and humans indiscriminately. Angoramon is taken over by the cursed katana.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E32 - Who Are You?
1.plot: Gammamon makes a new friend, who doesn’t show up even though they had agreed to hang out. Upon returning home, it seems that Hiro and the gang have forgotten all about Gammamon, and think that a completely different Digimon is Gammamon instead.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E33 - Whispers of the Dead
1.plot: One day, Kiyoshiro suddenly loses consciousness. He wakes up in the realm between the living world and the afterlife. Since then, he keeps hearing a voice in his head. He’s being targeted by a Digimon who can only befriend dead souls?!

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E34 - Wall Crawlers
1.plot: Kids around the neighborhood are turning into human geckos, and Hiro realizes one of them is his friend, Nanami. He consults the rest of the gang, who decide to help him with the investigation, when Ruli turns into a gecko herself.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E35 - Werewolf
1.plot: Ruli and the others go visit her ancestral home. There they find that the village is being terrorized by a local superstition, “the legend of the werewolf”. It is said that a sacrifice is needed to appease the werewolf's wrath.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E36 - Labyrinth of Grief
1.plot: There is a rumor going around about buildings disappearing on an urban legend website. Hiro and the gang go to investigate a certain cave with people from the forum. As they go deeper into the cave, terrible things happen.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E37 - Herd of the Dead
1.plot: Hiro and Ruli visit Kiyoshiro at his new job site where they hear about the rumors of pets and livestock disappearing around the area. It turns out that this area is haunted by zombies.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E38 - The Diviner
1.plot: Hiro and Kotaro visit their sister school in Kamakura. As Hiro participates in a traditional dance to calm the soul of the last young lord of the Hojo clan, he suddenly disappears. He was taken by a Digimon who is a diviner for the Hojo clan.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E39 - Contagion Island
1.plot: A violent Digimon comes to seek help from Hiro. He and the gang must then figure out how to return the dangerous Gyukimon, who is infecting and turning others into copies of Gyukimon, back to Ryudamon.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E40 - Spiral Beach
1.plot: Espimon’s arm is mysteriously twisted. Hiro and the gang go to the beach to investigate what could have caused this phenomenon, but they find that everything at the beach is twisted.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E41 - Clown
1.plot: Someone from the circus is luring children and turning them into cards. Ruli and Hiro sneak into the circus after Angoramon is kidnapped. It’s up to Ruli, Hiro, and Gammamon to put a stop to this.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E42 - Human Hunter
1.plot: Ruli decides to go investigate claims of oni demons kidnapping people when she receives a message through her social media. But Ruli and the gang get caught up in a sinister competition.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E43 - Red Eye
1.plot: Emma Hanes, a nosy friend from Kiyoshiro’s past, visits him. However, there is a strange phenomenon happening where people’s eyes first turn red, then their bodies become covered with numerous eyes.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E44 - Rust
1.plot: A first-year student in Hiro’s school is able to get his hands on rare and sought-after merchandise. Somehow, this is connected to the mysterious shaking buildings which Hiro hears about from Espimon.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E45 - Ghost Newspaper
1.plot: People start receiving newsletters with articles of terrible events that haven’t happened and are shocked and terrified to find out that they all come true. It seems a Digimon is behind this.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E46 - Queen's Banquet
1.plot: Kotaro is acting strange. He seems afraid of water which makes him run away, screaming. Even on the follow day, the sight of water still makes Kotaro tremble with fear. This worries Hiro, so with the help of his friends, he decides to investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E47 - Memory of Eternity
1.plot: A voice whispers into the ear of Shadramon, who is afraid of returning to Digitama form and forgetting everything. It says, “I'll leave those memories for you.” Soon after, Kiyoshiro realizes that something is wrong with his friend, Tamotsu.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E48 - The White Bride
1.plot: Ruli is asked to be a model for a wedding pamphlet and puts on a wedding dress. However, she is suddenly taken. It seems that brides in wedding dresses have been disappearing from local wedding halls.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E49 - The Crimson Harvest Festival
1.plot: It's Halloween season. Girls wearing witch costumes are being turned into real witches one by one. And the number of witches continues to grow. It seems a Digimon with some ulterior motive is behind all this.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E50 - Payback
1.plot: Hazakura Academy's first-year, Riku Fukatsu, is a long way from home and is having trouble fitting in when a Digimon takes an interest in him. However, things go awry when he has trouble reciprocating the Digimon's acts of kindness.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E51 - Headless
1.plot: A creepy, headless ghost resembling the legendary knight, the Dullahan, starts attacking students at Hazakura Academy. Apparently, the ghost is looking for its head. Kiyoshiro, for some reason, gets caught up in the middle of this chaos.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E52 - Mysterious Lake
1.plot: Hiro and his friends come to a lake where it is rumored that kappa haunt and drag humans underwater. Against Hiro's advice, Ruli goes near the lake at night and hears mysterious voices...

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E53 - King of Knowledge
1.plot: Kiyoshiro visits a shrine in Kyoto on a school trip. From then, someone starts to come pick Kiyoshiro up at night and challenges his knowledge. He then slowly starts forgetting things he should know.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E54 - Second Sight
1.plot: Hiro suddenly has the ability to see into the future. He is now able to detect accidents and troubles that those near him, such as Gammamon and Kotaro, may encounter. However, the side effects are very painful for Hiro.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E55 - Bakeneko
1.plot: Hiro watches the news about the rescue of a girl who woke up on the rooftop of a building. Kiyoshiro and Gammamon also begin acting strange, walking on top of fences and roofs. Apparently, there is a Digimon that tries to train humans.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E56 - Impurity
1.plot: Kotaro is acting strangely. He keeps repeating the word "Filthy" and washes his face over and over again. Gammamon instinctively senses something is wrong with him. Soon after, Kiyoshiro and all the dorm members start acting strangely too.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E57 - Ghost Taxi
1.plot: Hiro, Gammamon, and Kotaro go to see a Christmas play at a church. But on the way home, Kotaro and Gammamon are taken away by a black cab and disappear. Around the same time, a rumor about a ghost taxi starts to spread on an urban legend site.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E58 - Pyramid
1.plot: Kaoru, a friend from the piano class Ruli once attended, has gone missing. While searching for her, Ruli and the gang find a strange dent and her shoes. And as they continue their search, Hiro is suddenly asked a mysterious riddle.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E59 - Jiraiya
1.plot: Kiyoshiro goes out of town for work, where he meets Meru. They go see a Sentai action show together and encounter a Hologram Ghost. Kiyoshiro is somehow mistaken for Jiraiya and is forced to vanquish evil.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E60 - Water Ghost
1.plot: Jellymon, Kiyoshiro and the gang visit a festival and encounter a strange rain that was not forecasted. When the rain falls on someone, they become drowned and spit out water from their eyes and mouths.

meta.plot: High school freshman Hiro Amanokawa activates a mysterious device left behind by his father called "Digivice" that makes unknown creatures that cannot be seen by ordinary people, the Digimon, visible to his eyes. This is the story of this other side of the world that nobody is aware of. With their friends, Hiro and Gammamon dive into the mysterious world where these creatures live.

1.title: FR - La Vérité kidnappée : Du rêve au cauchemar américain - S01E01 - Part One: The Boyfriend
1.plot: In 2015, California couple Aaron Quinn and Denise Huskins were attacked at home during the night. After Denise was kidnapped, Aaron became a suspect.

1.title: FR - La Vérité kidnappée : Du rêve au cauchemar américain - S01E02 - Part Two: Gone Girl
1.plot: Days later, Denise reappears seemingly unharmed and recalls the details of her terrifying abduction as doubts from authorities begin to swirl.

1.title: FR - La Vérité kidnappée : Du rêve au cauchemar américain - S01E03 - Part Three: The Others
1.plot: More attempted kidnappings lead detectives to a new — and unexpected — suspect. Aaron and Denise go head-to-head with the Vallejo Police Department.

meta.plot: Dans cette série documentaire inspirée de crimes réels, un couple victime en 2015 d'une terrifiante effraction avec enlèvement se voit finalement accusé d'avoir tout orchestré.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E01 - Olives
1.plot: In Chaoshan, olives are preserved in distinct ways and appear in a variety of dishes, including fresh juices and meat soups.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E02 - Hu Tieu
1.plot: A quintessentially Chaoshan staple and a taste of home for many, kway teow (rice-noodle strips) can be stir-fried or wrapped around tasty fillings.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E03 - Marinated Crab
1.plot: Garlic. Cilantro. Chili pepper. The marinated raw-crab dish varies in style from Puning to Shantou, but it's always fresh and tender.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E04 - Brine
1.plot: Cinnamon, anise and galangal are among the spices that go into Chaoshan brine, a key ingredient in braised offal, goose head and hot pot.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E05 - Puning Bean Paste
1.plot: Long ago, migrants from the north brought soybeans to Chaoshan, now home to a unique bean paste featured in many dishes, from spinach to steamed fish.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E06 - Preserved Radish
1.plot: An age-old Chaoshan tradition, the preserved white radish can put an innovative spin on various dishes, from spare ribs to stir-fried squid.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E07 - Seaweed
1.plot: To bring out umami and impart the flavor of the sea, the versatile ingredient seaweed can be stir-fried, deep-fried, roasted and sprinkled on soup.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E08 - Oysters
1.plot: Steamed, marinated, stir-fried, grilled or dried. A classic in Chaoshan cuisine, the oyster is traditionally cultivated in the town of Jingzhou.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E09 - Chaozhou Mandarin Oranges
1.plot: A regional product, the Chaozhou orange can be deep-fried or dried and preserved to make sweet treats, while its peel can be used for zesty seasoning.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E10 - Lei Cha
1.plot: In the Hakka tradition, tea leaves are cooked with fresh herbs, then ground with sesame seeds or peanuts in a mortar to make lei cha, a fragrant drink.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E11 - Tofu Cake
1.plot: Garlic, fat, liquor and fermented bean curd. The traditional tofu cake is a baked pastry boasting a rich taste profile and centuries of history.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E12 - Beef Hot Pot
1.plot: Expert butchers in Chaoshan sharpen their knives to slice premium beef into perfect, marbled cutlets that are juicy, tender, and ready for hot pot.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E13 - Beef Meatballs
1.plot: Inheriting the techniques of previous generations, makers of Chaoshan beef meatballs dedicate hours of hard work to achieve perfect texture and flavor.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E14 - Yusheng
1.plot: Enjoyed with vegetables and dipping sauce, yu sheng (freshly sliced raw fish) is a delicacy with a long history in Chaoshan.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E15 - Meal of Fish
1.plot: Salted, boiled and air-dried in bamboo baskets, the mackerel scad is among many seafoods that make for a chewy, flavorful and simple main dish.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E16 - Fish Sauce
1.plot: Indispensable to Chaoshan cooking, fish sauce is traditionally made by salt-curing and fermenting hilsa herring, but new methods have cropped up.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E17 - Fish Ball and Wrapped Fish
1.plot: In Chaoshan, the lizardfish is deboned and pounded to make surimi (fish paste) -- a versatile ingredient with a uniquely smooth and elastic texture.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E18 - Mussels
1.plot: Harvested from Nan'ao Island's shores, mussels are a summer delicacy that can be cooked with basil, folded into spring rolls and added to fried rice.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E19 - Galangal
1.plot: Galangal arrived in Chaoshan from Southeast Asia a long time ago, imbuing meat dishes like chicken and lamb with a fragrant punch.

1.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S01E20 - Chinese Motherwort
1.plot: Known for both taste and nutritional value, Chinese motherwort is blanched and added to soup and congee as a breakfast favorite.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E01 - Dairy Products
2.plot: Yunnan is known for a variety of dairy products, including Dali rushan: thinly sliced cheese that can be fried, grilled or dipped in honey.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E02 - Nan Piӗ
2.plot: A local wild berry features in nanpie, which refers t different types of flavorful pastes made from mashed vegetables or fish.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E03 - Sa Piӗ
2.plot: Sa is a culinary tradition that pairs cold meat or raw vegetables with a versatile sauce that is often mixed with pig blood curd.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E04 - Lacquer Seed Oil
2.plot: Derived from the fruits of the Chinese lacquer tree, qiyou is an oil used to cook eggs, congee, pork stew, roast chicken and even bee larvae.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E05 - Ham
2.plot: Found in local moon cake fillings, Xuanwei cured ham can be thinly sliced, steamed, cooked with egg, stewed or served as cold cuts.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E06 - Pickled Vegetables
2.plot: Salted and partially dried, the sow thistle can be pickled and stir-fried with pork to lend a sour, crunchy flavour, or added to white radish stew.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E07 - Hardy Banana
2.plot: Wrapped in leaves with a sticky rice or spiced fish, the Musa basjoo – a banana found in Yunnan – can make for a sweet snack or savoury dish.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E08 - Sour Fruits
2.plot: Besides being an appetite stimulant, tart fruits like lemon and sour papaya can be added to shredded chicken, carp or a sauce for dousing live shrimp.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E09 - Rice Cake
2.plot: The er, a flattened rice flour cake, can be backed into a sticky snack, sliced and stir-fried with vegetables or julienned into noodle-like strands.

2.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S02E10 - Salted Flour
2.plot: Zha, an old custom, is an assortment of dried fermented vegetables or fish served as side dishes, made with ancient methods of food preservation.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E01 - Mutton
3.plot: In Jiayuguan city, mutton tallow envelops lamb skewers with layers of flavor. In the Ganjia pastures, herders cook lamb with tripe using hot stones.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E02 - Lily
3.plot: Baked, steamed or stir-fried, the root of the lily plant is sweet and aromatic. Its flower also serves as a salad ingredient or a noodle topping.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E03 - Cooked chopped entrails of sheep
3.plot: From Linxia to the Hexi Corridor, sheep offal can be found sizzling on hot plates, stuffed into casings and wrapped in caul fat.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E04 - Flaxseed
3.plot: In Wuwei County, watermelon farmers enjoy flaxseed rolls as a dry staple food. Flaxseed oil also infuses pastries like Yongdeng mooncake with aroma.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E05 - Gua Gua
3.plot: Grown in the Longdong plateaus, buckwheat can be made into jelly noodles, pancake batter and Tianshui guagua, a savory breakfast dish.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E06 - Beef noodles
3.plot: A slow-cooked beef broth is the soul of the hand-pulled Lanzhou beef noodle, a go-to dish for discerning eaters searching for a taste of home.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E07 - Gluten
3.plot: Baked, air-dried or sliced into strips, the absorbent wheat gluten can be added to soups and meaty stews, making it a perfect flavor reservoir.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E08 - Souherb
3.plot: Found in mullet roe and hot pot, souherb is a white soupy ingredient made by fermenting vegetables like endive, celery, carrot or cabbage.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E09 - Niang Pi
3.plot: From Lanzhou to Wuwei, epicures put a different spin on niang pi, a glutenous cold noodle dish that often comes with sesame, cucumber and chili oil.

3.title: FR - Flavorful Origins - S03E10 - Potato
3.plot: Dingxi boasts more than 30 varieties of potato, eaten sliced, mashed or made in the form of noodles cooked with pork or spicy sauces.

meta.plot:
Delve into the delectable world of Chaoshan cuisine, explore its unique ingredients and hear the stories of the people behind its creation.

In the second series of "Flavorful Origins", we discover the cuisine of Yunnan .

The third series of Flavorful Origins takes us around the cuisine of Gansu.

Modern history can be divided into two time frames: before 9/11 and after 9/11. This five-part docuseries is a cohesive chronicle of the September 11, 2001 attacks on the U.S., offering illuminating perspectives and personal stories of how the catastrophic events of that day changed the course of the nation.

1.title: FR - Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror - S01E01 - The System Was Blinking Red
1.plot: Interviews and chilling archival recordings chronicle the chaos that unfolded during the 9/11 attacks, whose origins can be traced to the 1980s.

1.title: FR - Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror - S01E02 - A Place of Danger
1.plot: Survivors recount the horrors they endured on 9/11. Immediately after the attacks, George W. Bush begins charting America's aggressive military response.

1.title: FR - Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror - S01E03 - The Dark Side
1.plot: Learning the hijackers benefitted from gaps in US intelligence, the White House justifies a secret surveillance program and "enhanced interrogation."

1.title: FR - Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror - S01E04 - The Good War
1.plot: With no cohesive strategy, the war in Afghanistan squanders early successes and backfires, fueling disillusionment, corruption and a Taliban resurgence.

1.title: FR - Turning Point: 9/11 and the War on Terror - S01E05 - Graveyard of Empires
1.plot: After two decades, the US aims to end its longest-ever war, but its withdrawal threatens to plunge Afghanistan back into repressive, bloody violence.

meta.plot: From training to launch to landing, this all-access docuseries rides along with the Inspiration4 crew on the first all-civilian orbital space mission.

1.title: FR - Compte à Rebours : Quatre Touristes dans l’Espace - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Preparations begin for the mission to send four civilians into orbit, and its charitable goals lead to a 29-year-old cancer survivor joining the crew.

1.title: FR - Compte à Rebours : Quatre Touristes dans l’Espace - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Principles of generosity and prosperity inform the selection of the last two crew members. Excitement for the flight ramps up, but anxiety lingers.

1.title: FR - Compte à Rebours : Quatre Touristes dans l’Espace - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As training begins, the crewmembers process the physical, mental and technical demands being placed on them. A climb of Mt. Rainier puts them to the test.

1.title: FR - Compte à Rebours : Quatre Touristes dans l’Espace - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A fighter jet ride prepares the crew for the G-forces of spaceflight. Hayley, Sian and Chris relate the emotions they experience as launch approaches.

1.title: FR - Compte à Rebours : Quatre Touristes dans l’Espace - S01E05 - Episode 5

meta.plot: From birth to brain surgery: This docuseries provides an intimate look at the lifesaving work of four doctors at Lenox Hill Hospital in NYC.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E01 - Growth Hurts
1.plot: Two neurosurgeons, an ER doctor and an OB-GYN fight to give their patients quality health care despite professional and personal challenges.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E02 - The Barrier
1.plot: Amanda Little-Richardson copes with a rare diagnosis for her unborn baby. David Langer's flawless brain surgery on Mitzie has an unexpected result.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E03 - Birth
1.plot: Mirtha Macri must overcome challenges to deliver her child. David fights for his team's expansion while a colleague receives a devastating diagnosis.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E04 - Together
1.plot: The neurosurgery team retreats to David's beach house, where Mitch Levine shares his news. Amanda's husband inadvertently reveals the baby's gender.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E05 - Undercurrents
1.plot: John Boockvar gives a family a grim update. David performs Mitzie's delicate procedure. The two doctors recall how their fathers shaped their careers.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E06 - Night of the Dead
1.plot: Halloween keeps the ER busy while the neurosurgeons operate on a young Brazilian woman whose surgery is prolonged by surprising lab findings.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E07 - Pain
1.plot: John's team deals with the crushing loss of a beloved patient. Mitch returns to work. Amanda comes to grips with a new development in her pregnancy.

1.title: FR - Lenox Hill: au coeur de l'hôpital - S01E08 - Full Circle
1.plot: A tough delivery has a happy outcome for Amanda, who prepares to leave New York. John's patient faces the end as David's team continues to grow.

meta.plot: Harley Quinn has finally broken things off once and for all with the Joker and attempts to make it on her own as the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E01 - 'Til Death Do Us Part
1.plot: Harley Quinn is fed up being the Joker’s sidekick and strikes out on her own – determined to become the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E02 - A High Bar
1.plot: Determined to become one of the vaunted Legion of Doom, Harley attempts to make a big splash by crashing one of their criminal enterprises with the help of her BFF, Poison Ivy.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E03 - So, You Need A Crew?
1.plot: Realizing she needs a crew to pull off heists that will attract the Legion of Doom’s attention, Harley attempts to recruit Dr. Psycho and Clayface.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E04 - Finding Mr. Right
1.plot: In search of a nemesis, Harley goes after Batman, but ends up with an adolescent Robin, making her the laughing stock of the criminal underworld.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E05 - Being Harley Quinn
1.plot: When Harley suffers a paralyzing identity crisis, her crew must enter Harley’s mind to free her with the help of Dr. Psycho’s telepathic powers.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E06 - You're a Damn Good Cop, Jim Gordon
1.plot: When Clayface loses his arm in a heist, it turns out to be not only evidence for Jim Gordon, but also a key witness against Harley and her crew.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E07 - The Line
1.plot: Harley recruits her friend and mentor Queen of Fables to help her steal a force field from STAR Labs, to steal a weather-changing machine, so she can impress the Legion of Doom. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy dates Kite Man.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E08 - L.O.D.R.S.V.P
1.plot: Harley gets an invite to the Legion of Doom’s prospective members party, but Ivy discovers that it’s Lex Luthor they’re really after.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E09 - A Seat at the Table
1.plot: Now a member of the Legion of Doom and The Joker’s equal, Harley finds herself spending time with him. Will she slip into her old ways?

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E10 - Bensonhurst
1.plot: After a falling out with her crew, Harley heads back home to Bensonhurst, where her doting mother waits for her... and her deadbeat dad, who’s more dangerous than anticipated.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E11 - Harley Quinn Highway
1.plot: Harley must rescue Ivy from the clutches of Scarecrow, who’s trying to harvest her pheromones to make a super toxin that turns plants into sentient monsters.

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E12 - Devil's Snare
1.plot: Harley thinks the Legion of Doom is behind Ivy's capture and the tree monsters currently ravaging Gotham. But it's a trap!

1.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S01E13 - The Final Joke
1.plot: In the season finale, Harley has her final showdown with the Joker, when [spoilers] [spoil] [spoilers]. Will they [spoiler]? Maybe. But you can bet they [spoiler]!

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E01 - New Gotham
2.plot: After Gotham is declared no longer part of the United States, the newly formed Injustice League tries to seize control of the city away from Harley.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E02 - Riddler U
2.plot: Harley & Ivy go undercover as college students to take down Riddler, who’s made himself dean of the local university with sinister plans for students.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E03 - Catwoman
2.plot: Harley & Ivy team up with Catwoman to steal a museum artifact that’s been boobytrapped by Dr. Trap. Meanwhile, Dr. Psycho tries to prove himself as a leader.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E04 - Thawing Hearts
2.plot: Harley and crew try to infiltrate Mr. Freeze's lair only to become human lab rats for his experiments to find a cure for his cryogenically frozen wife, Nora.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E05 - Batman's Back, Man
2.plot: Bruce Wayne awakens from his coma to Gotham in chaos.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E06 - All the Best Inmates Have Daddy Issues
2.plot: When Harley and Ivy spot a seemingly sane Joker, they debate whether people can change at their core, revisiting a flashback about Harleen Quinzel's first day at Arkham Asylum.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E07 - There's No Place to Go But Down
2.plot: Acting as a judge, Two Face sentences Harley and Ivy to life in Bane's prison. Meanwhile, Jim Gordon and Batgirl vow to take back the GCPD from Two Face.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E08 - Inner (Para) Demons
2.plot: While Harley & Ivy deal with their post-kiss awkwardness, the President tells Gordon that he must get rid of Harley to put Gotham back on the map.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E09 - Bachelorette
2.plot: It's Bachelor/Bachelorette weekend for Ivy and Kite Man.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E10 - Dye Hard
2.plot: Alone on Christmas Eve, Harley reconnects with a now-sane Joker and heads to Wayne Tower, where their dinner is interrupted by an escaped Riddler and ParaDemons.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E11 - A Fight Worth Fighting For
2.plot: In order to defeat Psycho's army, Harley & Joker need to track down Fables' storybook with the Justice League inside.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E12 - Lovers' Quarrel
2.plot: Psycho unleashes a mind-controlled Ivy, Clayface, and King Shark on the Justice League who are trying to free Gotham.

2.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S02E13 - Something Borrowed, Something Green
2.plot: Harley crashes Ivy's wedding to stop Gordon and his officers from interrupting the nuptials.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E01 - Harlivy
3.plot: After fleeing the wedding, Harley and Ivy go on an "Eat Bang Kill" tour that leads them to a secret project Ivy abandoned years ago.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E02 - There's No Ivy in Team
3.plot: After a heist gone wrong, Harley takes the crew to an escape room to foster camaraderie and sharpen Ivy’s leadership skills.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E04 - A Thief, A Mole, An Orgy
3.plot: When Frank goes missing, Harley and Ivy follow clues that lead them to a highly unconventional party alongside Gotham’s elite, including Commissioner Gordon – who is hungry for campaign donations.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E05 - It's a Swamp Thing
3.plot: Harley, Ivy, and Nora travel to New Orleans in search of Swamp Thing, who just might be able to help them find Frank.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E06 - Joker: The Killing Vote
3.plot: When The Joker runs for mayor of Gotham, Two Face attempts to sabotage his campaign.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E07 - Another Sharkley Adventure
3.plot: Harley infiltrates a gala on a mission to confront Frank's captor... only to be entangled in another evil plot.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E08 - Batman Begins Forever
3.plot: After Harley receives access to Bruce Wayne's mind, she gets stuck in an endless loop of his most formative memory.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E09 - Climax at Jazzapajizza
3.plot: When an inadvertent plant zombie apocalypse breaks out in Gotham, Harley fights to save the city, while Ivy embraces her inner supervillain.

3.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S03E10 - The Horse and The Sparrow
3.plot: After her terraforming plan goes awry, Ivy is enticed by an offer to take over the Legion of Doom, while Harley questions her path forward.

4.title: FR - Harley Quinn - S04E01 - Gotham's Hottest Hotties
