1.plot: After hearing about what happened in the past, Rei goes to Samezuka Academy to ask Rin what he wants. The night before Iwatobi and Samezuka leave for regionals, Rin calls Rei to explain how he feels about the relay. And then, Samezuka announces its lineup for the relay.

1.title: FR - Free! - S01E12 - Distant Free
1.plot: The Iwatobi Swim Club must win to advance to nationals. As the tournament draws near, the members get nervous. Meanwhile, Rin grows increasingly irritated. As it comes time for the medley relay, each member must find their own answer as they step up to the start line

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E01 - Stormy Dash-Dive!
2.plot: Haruka and his friends have grown after last summer’s tournament. Amidst the hustle and bustle of training for their individual events, their daily lives continue as usual. However, a new season now approaches!

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E02 - Stroke of an Unexpected Meeting!
2.plot: The crew ponders how to attract new members to the Swim Club. Haruka is called in by Amakata-sensei to discuss his intended career path, but as always, Haruka moves to the beat of his own drum. Meanwhile, Coach Sasabe brings an interesting opportunity to the boys…

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E03 - The Butterfly of Farewell!
2.plot: The Iwatobi Festival has begun! Haruka and friends are fired up for the Club-versus-Club Relay Race, hoping to attract new members by putting in an impressive performance. Meanwhile, Rei begins training but is worried by the fact that he can still only swim the butterfly stroke…

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E04 - The Promise's Somersault Turn!
2.plot: In anticipation of the upcoming prefectural tournament, the members of the Samezuka Swim Club enthusiastically show off their individual abilities. At the Iwatobi Swim Club, an equally enthusiastic Gou proposes a lunchbox inspection to ensure the boys are getting the right nutrition to support their training. However...

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E05 - A Resolution's Heads-Up!
2.plot: The members of the Iwatobi Swim Club ponder over the cause of Nagisa’s odd behavior at the end of practice that day. Though they time their chance well to ask Nagisa what’s happened, Nagisa stubbornly refuses to explain why he’s upset...

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E06 - Invincible Prime!
2.plot: On the eve of prefecturals, Makoto resolves himself to broach a certain subject with Haruka. As the tournament begins, the Iwatobi Swim Club is extremely enthusiastic about its prospects. But will every member be able to pass the prelims of his individual events?

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E07 - The Crouching Start of Vindication!
2.plot: Haruka and the boys have trained hard to prepare for this showdown against Samezuka. After Day 1 of the tournament, Gou and Amakata-sensei treat the boys to a fabulous, carb-rich feast and allow them to take a breather. Meanwhile, Rin is faced with a tough decision as captain of the Samezuka Swim Club. Who will he choose to swim the relay with him?

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E08 - The Locomotive of a Twist!
2.plot: While Haruka and the boys redouble their training in the wake of prefecturals, Makoto notices Gou looking troubled and asks her what’s wrong. She tells him that Coach Sasabe has been so busy with his Swim Club lately, he hasn’t been by to approve their new training regimen. Makoto offers to go see him for her, but what he finds at the Swim Club is...

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E09 - Forming of a Slump!
2.plot: At Samezuka Academy, the hot-blooded practices continue ahead of regionals. Meanwhile, the Iwatobi Swim Club trains diligently each day until sundown. Though Amakata-sensei is concerned, Haruka and the boys insist they want to practice as much as possible before the tournament.

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E10 - The Six-Beat Kick of Tears!
2.plot: As the tournament continues, Sousuke finally tells Rin about how he’s passed their years of separation. Rin is concerned at Sousuke’s nonchalant attitude toward certain things and tries to speak his mind. Meanwhile, the Iwatobi Swim Club looks toward the relay final.

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E11 - The Open Turn of Destiny!
2.plot: The Iwatobi Swim Club continues their training. However, signs of confusion seem to keep surfacing in the silent Haruka’s swimming. Makoto and the others are worried about him, but try to continue acting cheerfully as though nothing was wrong. But one day, Sousuke appears, asking to speak to Haruka…

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E12 - A Swim-Off in a Foreign Land!
2.plot: Upon Rin’s invitation, Haruka finds himself venturing to “a certain country.” Knowing that Haruka has hit a wall worrying about his future, Rin opens up and speaks to him about his own thoughts and feelings. Afterward, Rin quietly asks Haruka what he will do about his own future...

2.title: FR - Free! - S02E13 - The Eternal Summer of Beginnings!
2.plot: Having faced his feelings honestly at last, Haruka tells Makoto, Nagisa, and Rei what he has decided for himself and his future. The Iwatobi Swim Club is once again fully united as they mount the starting block at nationals, ready to swim for themselves, for their friends, and now, for the future as well.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E01 - Sprouting Dive Start!
3.plot: Haruka has entered Hidaka University, where he's now training with the swim club to prepare for a newcomer tournament. One day, he runs into Asahi, a swim teammate from middle school. Haruka is later joined by Makoto, who also moved to Tokyo, at a coffee shop to catch up with Asahi... and the topic quickly turns to Ikuya, another teammate they swam with in middle school. On the day of the newcomer tournament, Haruka and Asahi are in the same race for the first time in years... and the spectacle is watched by Hiyori, who calls Haruka an "inferior copy of Ikuya." After the race, as Haruka is walking through the halls with Asahi, he catches sight of Ikuya passing by..

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E02 - A Promise on a Shooting Star!
3.plot: Haruka and his relay teammates decide to hold a training camp in the summer of their second year of middle school. During the night, Haruka heads out to the pool and finds Ikuya looking up at the stars.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E03 - First Swim in Another Country!
3.plot: Rin, now living in Australia, trains hard every day with swimmers from all around the world. Then a Japanese guy shows up where his team is training, challenging each of his teammates to races and beating them one by one. Even Rin is surprised when this newcomer reveals his identity...

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E04 - Interference of Loss!
3.plot: Haru, Makoto, and Asahi visit Shimogami University in hopes of talking to Ikuya, but even after looking all over campus, they can't find him. Hiyori, however, notices them and makes it his mission to keep them from seeing Ikuya.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E05 - An Ominous Workout!
3.plot: The Iwatobi High School Swim Club is participating in a joint training camp with the Samezuka Academy and Soufuukan High School teams. Sousuke is also participating as an alumnus. In the midst of the excitement, Rei and Nagisa notice that something is odd about Romio's swimming. Then Shizuru tells them the story of what happened to Romio in middle school...

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E06 - The Mermaid of the Abyss!
3.plot: Hiyori still remembers the first time he saw Ikuya smile. Both boys grew stronger through rigorous training while they studied abroad in America... but seeing Haruka threw Ikuya off his stride. Now Hiyori wishes Ikuya would just forget about Haruka for good.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E07 - A Solitary Medley!
3.plot: With the college championships approaching, all the swimmers are training hard on their own in addition to their official club practices. Haruka is also undergoing some extra training, with coaching from the mysterious man they've been seeing around campus. Makoto is concerned about the arrangement, but Haruka assures him that he asked for the help himself

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E08 - Metamorphosis of the Soul!
3.plot: After the breakup of his middle school swim team, Ikuya decided to get stronger on his own and not rely on anyone. But Haruka, breaking out of his freestyle comfort zone to swim in the individual medley, tells Ikuya that he's not alone.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E09 - Interval in the Evening Calm!
3.plot: Haruka's next race is the All-Japan Invitational, which determines who will represent Japan at the global level. To prepare for this important tournament, Haruka is invited to a special training camp.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E10 - The Grab Start of Hope!
3.plot: Makoto has been unable to get in touch with Haruka following the friendly race at his training camp, making him worry that Haruka is dwelling on what happened. Then Nao approaches Makoto to tell him about a rumor he heard.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E11 - Streamline of Unity!
3.plot: Makoto meets up with the members of the Iwatobi Swim Club who are in Tokyo for the nationals. Meanwhile, Haru continues his training.

3.title: FR - Free! - S03E12 - Dive to the Future!
3.plot: Nagisa, Rei, and the rest of the Iwatobi Swim Club have come to cheer on their former teammates at the All-Japan Invitational. Makoto tells them the story of how ever since Haruka swam for the first time, he'd been swimming only freestyle.

meta.plot: Low on inspiration for his second book, a gloomy novelist agrees to write a memoir for a dying man — and swiftly becomes part of his bloodstained past.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Stuck in a creative rut, Adrien accepts a ghostwriting job from an aging man named Albert, who wants to pen the story of his lifelong love, Solange.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Nora leaks Adrien’s manuscript to his publisher. In the 70s, Albert and Solange spend bloody summers along the French Riviera.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Carrel uncovers a damning lead in the Powell cold case. As his relationship with Nora deteriorates, Adrien becomes acquainted with Albert’s friends.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Albert remembers one particularly close call and a rough patch with Solange. Adrien descends into old vices. Mathilde looks into Carrel’s disappearance.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After discovering the link between Albert and Nastya, Adrien demands they finish the book — but he doesn’t expect the ending to include himself.

1.title: FR - Black Butterflies - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: One year later, an eyewitness account sends Adrien back to Brussels in search of the truth. Mathilde’s search for Carrel comes to a close.

1.title: FR - The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin - S01E01 - A Legend Is Born (Sort Of)
1.plot: Destiny calls when butcher's assistant Dick Turpin befriends a gang of outlaws and steps into the swashbuckling spotlight.

1.title: FR - The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin - S01E02 - The Unrobbable Coach
1.plot: In a bid to prove himself to the highwaymen, Dick vows to rob a cursed stagecoach... and faces the consequences. Nell explores a new opportunity.

1.title: FR - The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin - S01E03 - Run Wilde
1.plot: The gang's trip to London dissolves into chaos when a gold deal falls apart. Wilde faces pressure to end Dick once and for all.

1.title: FR - The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin - S01E04 - Curse of the Reddlehag
1.plot: A routine holdup turns hellish when Dick and the gang accidentally free a powerful witch. Craig attempts to pass his warlock exam.

meta.plot: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he's made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.

A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E01 - A Leap
1.plot: Antonia Scott is the most intelligent woman in the world –a virtue and a curse at the same time. Her intelligence allowed her to become the "Red Queen" of a secret experimental police project. But a personal tragedy removed her from active duty. Now, Jon Gutiérrez, a police officer in trouble, has to get her out of her seclusion to solve a case that will put her abilities and her past to the test.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E02 - A Tattoo
1.plot: Ezequiel has assassinated Álvaro Trueba and has kidnapped Carla Ortiz, both the firstborn of the most powerful families in Spain. Jon agrees to be Antonia's squire. Even though they started off with the wrong foot, they're about to catch Ezequiel after a fast-paced chase that has everyone on edge. In her cell, Carla finds out that she is not Ezequiel's only prisoner.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E03 - A Pill
1.plot: Antonia and Jon have barely started and they have already got the Kidnapping Unit, Ramón Ortiz, Laura Trueba and the shadow leader of Reina Roja, Mentor, against them. During the course of the investigation, everyone lies. Antonia and Jon realize that what Ezequiel has asked of Ortiz and Trueba is an admission of guilt. But Ezequiel is always one step ahead and now his threat looms over Antonia.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E04 - A Spanish Tortilla
1.plot: Antonia wakes up alone facing a mural. Why didn't Ezequiel kill her? The assassin wanted to deliver a message. A message that leads Antonia and Jon to a taxi car and to discover the true identity behind Ezequiel. The Kidnapping Unit has also found Ezequiel's address and taxi car, but Antonia notices that the pieces don't fit together as neatly...

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E05 - A Choice
1.plot: Antonia and Jon find out Ezequiel's daughter is helping him, but things don't add up. They have committed too many mistakes. But when the Kidnapping Unit falls into a trap, they realize they weren't mistakes. Carla discovers the truth about the kidnapped woman in the other cell. Jon makes a blunder that causes Mentor to close the case and remove Antonia from her position as the Spanish Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E06 - A Disguise
1.plot: Antonia's father accuses her of kidnapping her own son and is about to get her arrested, but Jon helps her escape. Alone and with all the city police behind her, Antonia seeks to hide in order to think of a rescue plan for her child. With the help of her memories, her mind, her old friends... and a costume, Antonia is about to take on the most important mission of her life.

1.title: FR - Red Queen - S01E07 - A Mirror
1.plot: Jon and Antonia get back together. The Queen and her squire have little time left and must go to underground tunnels riddled with traps and bombs. Sandra and Ezequiel are waiting for them and the lives of Jorge and Carla are at stake. But Antonia knows this is not over. Sandra is not who she says she is, but just a prophet of someone more powerful who already destroyed what Antonia loved most.

meta.plot: A series of murders take place in 16th-century Seville, where the plague has taken hold; a condemned man faces the Inquisition as he attempts to save the son of a friend by speaking out.
When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E01 - Welcome to Colorado
1.plot: After a tragic loss, Jackie moves in with the Walters and tries to adjust to small-town life. But a new home and new high school bring new challenges.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E02 - Live a Little
1.plot: When the brothers make a bet involving a prank on Jackie, she turns to Katherine but learns that the boys have their own way of handling their issues.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E03 - The Cole Effect
1.plot: At the Homecoming Huddle, Alex and Jackie run the Walter family cider cart together with help from Cole, who struggles to accept life without football.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E04 - Nineteen
1.plot: On Lucy's birthday, Jackie decides to skip school and attend a lake house party with Cole, where the two play a high-stakes version of Truth or Dare.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E05 - Thanksgiving
1.plot: Jackie wants to avoid the first Thanksgiving without her family, but a surprise visitor lifts her mood and presents her with a difficult choice.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E06 - Baggage
1.plot: Before the big bonfire, Jackie learns about Cole and Alex's history with another girl. At the party, relationships new and old go up in flames.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E07 - Small Town Rumors
1.plot: As rumors fly about the Walter boys, Alex and Cole's sibling rivalry reaches its breaking point. Later, the family deals with an unsettling emergency.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E08 - Spinning Out
1.plot: When Katherine wins an award for her veterinarian work, the family jumps to support her — except Cole, who instead heads down a path of self-destruction.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E09 - Revolutions
1.plot: Jackie misses Alex's county fair rodeo for an important interview and tries to keep her distance from Cole after their hurtful exchange.

1.title: FR - My Life with the Walter Boys - S01E10 - Happily Ever After
1.plot: With the Walter boys' help, Jackie diligently plans a picture-perfect ranch wedding. But no amount of checklists can prepare her for what happens next.

meta.plot: Dans la Chine des années 60, une jeune femme prend une décision dont les répercussions à travers le temps et l'espace vont affecter le monde d'aujourd'hui. Lorsque les lois de la nature se délitent inexplicablement sous les yeux d'un groupe soudé de brillants scientifiques, ils unissent leurs forces à celles d'un inspecteur peu orthodoxe pour affronter la plus grande menace de l'histoire de l'humanité.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E01 - Countdown
1.plot: Unsettling events put a group of brilliant friends on edge as a mystery unravels with origins tracing back to China during the Cultural Revolution.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E02 - Red Coast
1.plot: Auggie's countdown jeopardizes her nanotech work. Jin becomes engrossed in an otherworldly VR game. Ye Wenjie follows through on a radical idea.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E03 - Destroyer of Worlds
1.plot: Obsessed with their virtual reality quest, Jin and Jack race to solve a complex riddle — but advancing to the next level brings harrowing consequences.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E04 - Our Lord
1.plot: Jin seeks justice after a death rattles the group. Investigators learn of an extremist group devoted to an otherworldly entity ahead of a major summit.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E05 - Judgment Day
1.plot: As threat levels rise, a secret mission to retrieve enemy intel ventures into dangerous territory. An ominous message reaches Earth.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E06 - The Stars Our Destination
1.plot: With the world in a state of panic following a momentous declaration, Wade gathers the world's greatest minds to prepare a defense plan.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E07 - Only Advance
1.plot: A bold proposition for the Staircase Project puts the group at odds. Will weighs his options. Ye returns to a familiar place.

1.title: FR - Le Problème à 3 corps - S01E08 - Wallfacer
1.plot: A high-level operation upends Saul's life. With emotions and expectations high, the probe launches into space as humanity enters a daunting new era.
